dict[str, Any], dedupe_key: str) -> Optional[MemoryJob]:\n        \"\"\"Enqueue a new job with deduplication.\"\"\"\n        return None\n\n    def claim_next(self) -> Optional[MemoryJob]:\n        \"\"\"Claim the next Ready job with a unique lease token.\"\"\"\n        return None\n\n    def mark_done(self, job_id: str, claim_token: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Mark job Done guarded by claim token matching.\"\"\"\n        return False\n\n\nclass MemoryQueueManager:\n    \"\"\"Core Memory Queue Manager implementing Spec §4.8.\"\"\"\n\n    CLAIM_LEASE_SECONDS = 300.0  # 5 minutes\n\n    def __init__(self, enabled: bool = True, max_workers: int = 2):\n        self.enabled = enabled\n        self.max_workers = max_workers\n        self._jobs: dict[str, MemoryJob] = {}\n\n    def enqueue(self, kind: JobKind, payload: dict[str, Any], dedupe_key: str) -> Optional[MemoryJob]:\n        \"\"\"Enqueue a job. If an active job with same dedupe_key exists, ignore.\"\"\"\n        if not self.enabled or self.max_workers == 0:\n            return None\n\n        # Check deduplication against Ready or Running jobs\n        for job in self._jobs.values():\n            if job.dedupe_key == dedupe_key and job.status in (JobStatus.READY, JobStatus.RUNNING):\n                return job\n\n        job_id = f\"job-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}\"\n        job = MemoryJob(\n            id=job_id,\n            kind=kind,\n            payload=payload,\n            dedupe_key=dedupe_key,\n            status=JobStatus.READY,\n        )\n        self._jobs[job_id] = job\n        return job\n\n    def claim_next(self) -> Optional[MemoryJob]:\n        \"\"\"Atomically claim the oldest Ready job and assign a lease token.\"\"\"\n        if not self.enabled or self.max_workers == 0:\n            return None\n\n        self.recover_stale_locks()\n\n        ready_jobs = [j for j in self._jobs.values() if j.status == JobStatus.READY]\n        if not ready_jobs:\n            return None\n\n        # Oldest first\n        ready_jobs.sort(key=lambda j: j.created_at)\n        job = ready_jobs[0]\n\n        token = uuid.uuid4().hex\n        job.status = JobStatus.RUNNING\n        job.claim_token = token\n        job.claimed_at = time.time()\n        return job\n\n    def mark_done(self, job_id: str, claim_token: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Settle job as Done only if claim_token matches.\"\"\"\n        job = self._jobs.get(job_id)\n        if not job or job.claim_token != claim_token:\n            return False\n\n        job.status = JobStatus.DONE\n        job.completed_at = time.time()\n        return True\n\n    def mark_failed(self, job_id: str, claim_token: str, error: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Settle job as Failed only if claim_token matches.\"\"\"\n        job = self._jobs.get(job_id)\n        if not job or job.claim_token != claim_token:\n            return False\n\n        job.retry_count += 1\n        if job.retry_count < 3:\n            # Requeue for retry\n            job.status = JobStatus.READY\n            job.claim_token = None\n            job.claimed_at = None\n        else:\n            job.status = JobStatus.FAILED\n            job.error_message = error\n            job.completed_at = time.time()\n        return True\n\n    def recover_stale_locks(self) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Reset running jobs whose claim lease has expired back to Ready.\"\"\"\n        now = time.time()\n        recovered = 0\n        for job in self._jobs.values():\n            if job.status == JobStatus.RUNNING and job.claimed_at:\n                if (now - job.claimed_at) > self.CLAIM_LEASE_SECONDS:\n                    job.status = JobStatus.READY\n                    job.claim_token = None\n                    job.claimed_at = None\n                    recovered += 1\n        return recovered\n",

{
  "CodeContent": "/**\n * locus-extension/src/providers/memory/queue.ts - Memory Queue Client\n *\n * Implements Spec §4.8 (Async Memory Job Pipeline).\n */\n\nexport type JobKind = \"ExtractChunk\" | \"AppendBuffer\" | \"Seal\" | \"TopicRoute\" | \"DigestDaily\" | \"FlushStale\";\nexport type JobStatus = \"Ready\" | \"Running\" | \"Done\" | \"Failed\";\n\nexport interface MemoryJob {\n  id: string;\n  kind: JobKind;\n  payload: Record<string, unknown>;\n  dedupe_key: string;\n  status: JobStatus;\n  claim_token?: string;\n  created_at: number;\n}\n\nexport interface MemoryQueueProvider {\n  enqueue(kind: JobKind, payload: Record<string, unknown>, dedupeKey: string): Promise<MemoryJob | null>;\n  claimNext(): Promise<MemoryJob | null>;\n  markDone(jobId: string, claimToken: string): Promise<boolean>;\n}\n\nexport class RemoteMemoryQueueProvider implements MemoryQueueProvider {\n  private endpoint: string;\n  private enabled: boolean;\n\n  constructor(options: { endpoint?: string; enabled?: boolean } = {}) {\n    this.endpoint = options.endpoint ?? \"http://127.0.0.1:8420/memory/queue\";\n    this.enabled = options.enabled ?? true;\n  }\n\n  public isEnabled(): boolean {\n    return this.enabled;\n  }\n\n  public async enqueue(kind: JobKind, payload: Record<string, unknown>, dedupeKey: string): Promise<MemoryJob | null> {\n    if (!this.enabled) return null;\n    try {\n      const res = await fetch(`${this.endpoint}/enqueue`, {\n        method: \"POST\",\n        headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\n        body: JSON.stringify({ kind, payload, dedupe_key: dedupeKey }),\n      });\n      if (!res.ok) return null;\n      return (await res.json()) as MemoryJob;\n    } catch {\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  public async claimNext(): Promise<MemoryJob | null> {\n    if (!this.enabled) return null;\n    try {\n      const res = await fetch(`${this.endpoint}/claim`, { method: \"POST\" });\n      if (!res.ok) return null;\n      return (await res.json()) as MemoryJob;\n    } catch {\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  public async markDone(jobId: string, claimToken: string): Promise<boolean> {\n    if (!this.enabled) return false;\n    try {\n      const res = await fetch(`${this.endpoint}/done`, {\n        method: \"POST\",\n        headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\n        body: JSON.stringify({ job_id: jobId, claim_token: claimToken }),\n      });\n      return res.ok;\n    } catch {\n      return false;\n    }\n  }\n}\n",

## Feature §4.9: Memory Diff (Snapshot-Based Change Tracking)



**Status**: complete  

**Verdict**: 🆕 LOCUS-NEW (OpenHuman module, no Pi/Hermes equivalent)



### Source(s) mined

- **Codebase**: OpenHuman `memory_diff/` module — `mod.rs` (33 lines), `types.rs`, `store.rs`, `ops.rs`, `tools.rs`

- **Query method**: [✅ VERIFIED: direct file read of `memory_diff/mod.rs`]



### Logic extracted



```

MEMORY DIFF (from OpenHuman memory_diff/ — COMPLETE):



  PURPOSE: Snapshot-based change tracking for memory sources.

  After each sync, captures what's in the chunk store, then diffs against

  previous snapshots to surface additions, removals, and modifications.

  Helps agents understand how their world view changed over time.



  ═══ CORE TYPES ═══

  

  Snapshot {

    id: UUID,

    source_scope: str,        // e.g. "vault:daily", "github:owner/repo"

    trigger: SnapshotTrigger, // AutoPostSync | Manual | Checkpoint

    items: [SnapshotItem],

    created_at: DateTime,

  }

  

  SnapshotItem {

    chunk_id: str,

    content_hash: str,        // SHA-256 of chunk content

    title: Option<str>,

    token_count: u32,

  }

  

  DiffResult {

    source_scope: str,

    from_snapshot: UUID,

    to_snapshot: UUID,

    changes: [ItemChange],

    summary: DiffSummary,

  }

  

  ItemChange {

    kind: ChangeKind,         // Added | Removed | Modified

    chunk_id: str,

    title: Option<str>,

    old_hash: Option<str>,    // for Modified

    new_hash: Option<str>,    // for Added and Modified

  }

  

  DiffSummary {

    added: u32,

    removed: u32,

    modified: u32,

    unchanged: u32,

  }



  ═══ OPERATIONS ═══

  

  FUNCTION take_snapshot(source_scope, trigger):

    items = store.get_all_chunks(source_scope)

              .map(c => SnapshotItem {

                chunk_id: c.id,

                content_hash: sha256(c.content),

                title: c.title,

                token_count: c.token_count

              })

    snapshot = Snapshot { source_scope, trigger, items, created_at: now() }

    store.save_snapshot(snapshot)

    RETURN snapshot.id

  

  FUNCTION diff(source_scope, from_id, to_id):

    from_items = store.get_snapshot(from_id).items  // keyed by chunk_id

    to_items   = store.get_snapshot(to_id).items

    

    changes = []

    FOR chunk_id IN union(from_items.keys, to_items.keys):

      IF chunk_id IN to_items AND NOT IN from_items:

        changes.push(ItemChange { kind: Added, ... })

      ELIF chunk_id IN from_items AND NOT IN to_items:

        changes.push(ItemChange { kind: Removed, ... })

      ELIF from_items[chunk_id].content_hash != to_items[chunk_id].content_hash:

        changes.push(ItemChange { kind: Modified, ... })

    

    RETURN DiffResult { changes, summary: count_by_kind(changes) }



  ═══ NAMED CHECKPOINTS ═══

  

  Checkpoint {

    name: str,               // e.g. "before-refactor", "weekly-baseline"

    snapshot_ids: { source_scope → snapshot_id }

  }

  

  FUNCTION create_checkpoint(name):

    FOR EACH active source_scope:

      snap_id = take_snapshot(source_scope, Checkpoint)

      checkpoint.snapshot_ids[source_scope] = snap_id

    store.save_checkpoint(name, checkpoint)

  

  FUNCTION diff_since_checkpoint(name):

    checkpoint = store.get_checkpoint(name)

    diffs = {}

    FOR EACH scope, snap_id IN checkpoint.snapshot_ids:

      current = take_snapshot(scope, Manual)

      diffs[scope] = diff(scope, snap_id, current)

    RETURN CrossSourceDiff { diffs }



  ═══ AGENT TOOL ═══

  

  MemoryDiffTool:

    "what_changed" action → diff_since_checkpoint or diff last N snapshots

    Returns human-readable summary: "3 notes added, 1 modified, 0 removed"



  ═══ RPC SURFACE ═══

  

  memory_diff.take_snapshot(source_scope, trigger?)

  memory_diff.diff(source_scope, from_snapshot_id, to_snapshot_id)

  memory_diff.create_checkpoint(name)

  memory_diff.diff_since_checkpoint(name)

  memory_diff.list_snapshots(source_scope, limit?)

```



### Locus adaptation

- **Component**: `locus/providers/memory/diff.ts` + `sidecar/memory/diff_ops.py`

- **Provider Interface**: Part of `MemoryProvider` infrastructure; the `MemoryDiffTool` is registered as a Locus agent tool

- **Repo vs `.locus`**: diff library in `locus-os` (repo); snapshot SQLite DB at `.locus/memory/snapshots.db`

- **STEAL VERBATIM**: The snapshot/diff pattern, the named checkpoint system, the SHA-256 content hashing, the agent tool interface

- **ADAPT**: Snapshots auto-triggered after VaultCrawler sync (daily) and Telegram conversation capture. Checkpoints created at weekly synthesis boundary.

- **Swappable / off state**: `locus.memory.diff.enabled`. Off → no snapshot tracking; agents cannot query "what changed"

## Feature §4.16: Context Compression



### Source

- **Codebases**: Hermes (`context_engine.py`, `context_compressor.py`, `conversation_compression.py`) + Pi (`compaction/`)

- **Verification**: [✅ VERIFIED: `context_engine.py` (227 lines full), `conversation_compression.py` (80 lines head)]



### Stripped Logic (Pseudocode)



```

CONTEXT ENGINE ABC (from Hermes context_engine.py):



    ABSTRACT CLASS ContextEngine:

        // Identity

        name: str               // "compressor", "lcm", etc.

        

        // Token tracking (maintained by engine, read by runtime)

        last_prompt_tokens: int

        threshold_tokens: int   // = context_length * threshold_percent

        context_length: int     // model's context window

        compression_count: int

        

        // Compaction parameters

        threshold_percent: float = 0.75   // compress at 75% usage

        protect_first_n: int = 3          // keep first 3 non-system messages

        protect_last_n: int = 6           // keep last 6 messages

        

        // Core methods:

        update_from_response(usage)      // called after every LLM call

        should_compress(prompt_tokens)   // check if compaction needed

        compress(messages, current_tokens, focus_topic) // do the compaction

        

        // Lifecycle:

        on_session_start(session_id)

        on_session_end(session_id, messages)

        on_session_reset()               // reset counters

        

        // Optional: expose tools

        get_tool_schemas() → []

        handle_tool_call(name, args) → json_string

        

        // Model switch support

        update_model(model, context_length, ...) // recalculate thresholds



COMPRESSION FLOW (from Hermes conversation_compression.py):

    

    FUNCTION compress_context(agent, messages, focus_topic=None):

        // Step 1: Acquire compression lock (prevent concurrent compressions)

        lock = acquire_lock(holder=compression_lock_holder(agent))

        

        // Step 2: Identify compressible range

        head = messages[:protect_first_n + 1]  // system + first N

        tail = messages[-protect_last_n:]      // last N

        middle = messages[protect_first_n + 1 : -protect_last_n]

        

        IF middle.length == 0:

            RETURN messages  // nothing to compress

        

        // Step 3: Notify memory providers before compression

        FOR EACH provider IN memory_providers:

            extra_context = provider.on_pre_compress(middle)

            //

### Metadata

- **Source Codebase**: `headroomlabs-ai/headroom` — **CLONED** at `5_Locus/deps/headroom`, actual source read.

- **Verification**: [✅ VERIFIED: cloned repo, source read] · `repo_cloned: true` · `logic_stripped: true` · `contains_code: false`



### Files involved (real, not guessed)



| File | Purpose | Interacts With |

|------|---------|---------------|

| `headroom/compress.py` | One-function API: `compress(messages, model, ...)` → `CompressResult`; `CompressConfig` knobs | `headroom/transforms/pipeline.py` |

| `headroom/transforms/cache_aligner.py` | Stabilizes message prefix so provider KV cache still hits | `transforms/pipeline.py` |

| `headroom/transforms/content_router.py` | Routes each content type to the right compressor | `transforms/*` |

| `headroom/transforms/smart_crusher.py` | JSON compressor (array dedup, lossless-first + lossy fallback) | `content_router.py` |

| `headroom/transforms/code_compressor.py` | Code (AST/structural) compressor | `content_router.py` |

| `headroom/transforms/kompress_compressor.py` | ML text compressor (HuggingFace `chopratejas/kompress-v2-base`) | `content_router.py` |

| `headroom/ccr/*` | **C**ache-**C**ompress-**R**etrieve: reversible; originals cached locally, retrievable within TTL | `compress.py`, MCP server |

| `headroom/client.py` / `headroom/cli.py` | Proxy + CLI entrypoints | `compress.py` |



### Logic extracted



Headroom compresses a message list **before it reaches the LLM**, with a typed pipeline:



`CacheAligner → ContentRouter → [SmartCrusher (JSON) | CodeCompressor (code) | Kompress-v2-base (text)] → CCR`



Key facts that drive the Locus adaptation:



- **It compresses the whole message array, not one string.** Defaults are tuned for coding agents: `compress_user_messages=False`, `protect_recent=4`, `min_tokens_to_compress=250` (short messages untouched).

- **Content-aware routing** — JSON goes to SmartCrusher (lossless array dedup first, lossy only if still over budget), code to CodeCompressor, prose to the ML Kompress model. `target_ratio` controls aggression (None ≈ 15% kept; 0.5 = keep 50%).

- **Reversible (CCR)**: originals are cached locally with a key; the LLM calls `headroom_retrieve(cache_key)` to get the full text back on demand, within a TTL.

- **Inflation guard**: if a transform *increases* token count, Headroom reverts to the originals (never make it worse).

- **Prompt-cache aware**: `CacheAligner` + `frozen_message_count` prevent rewriting a prefix the provider is already caching (so a 0.1× cache read isn't turned into a full-price rewrite).



### Pseudocode / algorithm



```

compress(messages, model, config) -> CompressResult:

    cfg = resolve(CompressConfig, kwargs)            # protect_recent=4, min_tokens=250, ...

    context = extract_user_query(messages)           # so JSON crusher scores relevance, not stats

    result = pipeline.apply(messages, model, model_limit, context, ...)

        # 1. CacheAligner: anchor frozen prefi




```

STDP ASYMMETRIC LEARNING RULE:

    CONSTANTS:

        A_plus  = 0.15     // Max potentiation (strengthening)

        A_minus = 0.12     // Max depression (weakening)

        tau_plus  = 300.0  // Positive time constant (5 minutes in seconds)

        tau_minus = 600.0  // Negative time constant (10 minutes in seconds)

        W_MIN = 0.05       // Minimum edge weight (prevents complete deletion)

        W_MAX = 1.00       // Maximum edge weight saturation

        PRUNE_THRESHOLD = 0.08  // Below this, edge is marked for archive/prune



DATA STRUCTURES:

    RetrievalEvent:

        node_id: string

        edge_id: string

        retrieved_at: float   // epoch timestamp



    OutcomeEvent:

        session_id: string

        turn_id: string

        success: bool         // 👍 reward, goal completion, or accepted suggestion

        occurred_at: float



FUNCTION apply_stdp_update(retrieval: RetrievalEvent, outcome: OutcomeEvent, current_weight: float) -> float:

    delta_t = outcome.occurred_at - retrieval.retrieved_at   // in seconds

    

    IF delta_t <= 0:

        // Retrieval happened AFTER outcome — causality violation, ignore

        RETURN current_weight

        

    IF outcome.success:

        // Long-Term Potentiation (LTP): Retrieved memory contributed to success

        delta_w = A_plus * exp(-delta_t / tau_plus)

        new_weight = current_weight + delta_w

    ELSE:

        // Long-Term Depression (LTD): Retrieved memory led to hallucination, rejection, or error

        delta_w = A_minus * exp(-delta_t / tau_minus)

        new_weight = current_weight - delta_w

        

    // Clamp to valid boundary

    new_weight = clamp(new_weight, W_MIN, W_MAX)

    RETURN new_weight



BATCH GRAPH REINFORCEMENT CYCLE:

    FUNCTION process_turn_stdp(turn_audit_log):

        FOR EACH edge IN turn_audit_log.traversed_edges:

            updated_w = apply_stdp_update(edge.retrieval_event, turn_audit_log.outcome, current_w)

            neo4j.update_edge_weight(edge.id, updated_w)

    FUNCTION calculate_next_review(state: MemoryNodeState, quality_grade: int) -> MemoryNodeState:

                state.interval_days = 1

            ELIF state.repetition_count == 1:

                state.interval_days = 6

            ELSE:

                state.interval_days = round(state.interval_days * state.ease_factor)

            state.repetition_count += 1

        ELSE:

            state.repetition_count = 0

            state.interval_days = 1

            

        // Update Ease Factor (EF)

        // EF' = EF + (0.1 - (5 - q) * (0.08 + (5 - q) * 0.02))

{
  "CodeContent": "/**\n * Memory Diff (Snapshot-Based Change Tracking) (§4.9)\n *\n * Tracks chunk-level diffs across sync events and checkpoint windows.\n */\n\nexport type SnapshotTrigger = \"AutoPostSync\" | \"Manual\" | \"Checkpoint\";\nexport type ChangeKind = \"Added\" | \"Removed\" | \"Modified\";\n\nexport interface SnapshotItem {\n  chunk_id: string;\n  content_hash: string;\n  title?: string;\n  token_count: number;\n}\n\nexport interface Snapshot {\n  id: string;\n  source_scope: string;\n  trigger: SnapshotTrigger;\n  items: SnapshotItem[];\n  created_at: string;\n}\n\nexport interface ItemChange {\n  kind: ChangeKind;\n  chunk_id: string;\n  title?: string;\n  old_hash?: string;\n  new_hash?: string;\n}\n\nexport interface DiffSummary {\n  added: number;\n  removed: number;\n  modified: number;\n  unchanged: number;\n}\n\nexport interface DiffResult {\n  source_scope: string;\n  from_snapshot: string;\n  to_snapshot: string;\n  changes: ItemChange[];\n  summary: DiffSummary;\n}\n\nexport class MemoryDiffManager {\n  private snapshotsByScope: Map<string, Snapshot[]> = new Map();\n  private checkpointsByScope: Map<string, Snapshot> = new Map();\n\n  public recordSnapshot(\n    sourceScope: string,\n    items: SnapshotItem[],\n    trigger: SnapshotTrigger = \"AutoPostSync\"\n  ): Snapshot {\n    const snap: Snapshot = {\n      id: \"snap-\" + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 10),\n      source_scope: sourceScope,\n      trigger,\n      items,\n      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n    const list = this.snapshotsByScope.get(sourceScope) || [];\n    list.push(snap);\n    this.snapshotsByScope.set(sourceScope, list);\n    return snap;\n  }\n\n  public createCheckpoint(sourceScope: string, items?: SnapshotItem[]): Snapshot {\n    let snap: Snapshot;\n    if (items) {\n      snap = this.recordSnapshot(sourceScope, items, \"Checkpoint\");\n    } else {\n      const list = this.snapshotsByScope.get(sourceScope) || [];\n      snap = list.length > 0 ? list[list.length - 1] : this.recordSnapshot(sourceScope, [], \"Checkpoint\");\n    }\n    this.checkpointsByScope.set(sourceScope, snap);\n    return snap;\n  }\n\n  public diff(\n    sourceScope: string,\n    fromSnap: Snapshot | undefined,\n    toSnap: Snapshot\n  ): DiffResult {\n    const fromMap = new Map<string, SnapshotItem>();\n    if (fromSnap) {\n      for (const item of fromSnap.items) {\n        fromMap.set(item.chunk_id, item);\n      }\n    }\n    const toMap = new Map<string, SnapshotItem>();\n    for (const item of toSnap.items) {\n      toMap.set(item.chunk_id, item);\n    }\n\n    const allKeys = new Set<string>([...fromMap.keys(), ...toMap.keys()]);\n    const changes: ItemChange[] = [];\n    const summary: DiffSummary = { added: 0, removed: 0, modified: 0, unchanged: 0 };\n\n    for (const cid of Array.from(allKeys).sort()) {\n      const inFrom = fromMap.get(cid);\n      const inTo = toMap.get(cid);\n\n      if (inTo && !inFrom) {\n        changes.push({\n          kind: \"Added\",\n          chunk_id: cid,\n          title: inTo.title,\n          new_hash: inTo.content_hash,\n        });\n        summary.added++;\n      } else if (inFrom && !inTo) {\n        changes.push({\n          kind: \"Removed\",\n          chunk_id: cid,\n          title: inFrom.title,\n          old_hash: inFrom.content_hash,\n        });\n        summary.removed++;\n      } else if (inFrom && inTo) {\n        if (inFrom.content_hash !== inTo.content_hash) {\n          changes.push({\n            kind: \"Modified\",\n            chunk_id: cid,\n            title: inTo.title || inFrom.title,\n            old_hash: inFrom.content_hash,\n            new_hash: inTo.content_hash,\n          });\n          summary.modified++;\n        } else {\n          summary.unchanged++;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    return {\n      source_scope: sourceScope,\n      from_snapshot: fromSnap ? fromSnap.id : \"empty\",\n      to_snapshot: toSnap.id,\n      changes,\n      summary,\n    };\n  }\n\n  public diffSinceCheckpoint(sourceScope: string, currentItems?: SnapshotItem[]): DiffResult {\n    const ckpt = this.checkpointsByScope.get(sourceScope);\n    const toSnap: Snapshot = currentItems\n      ? {\n          id: \"snap-eval\",\n          source_scope: sourceScope,\n          trigger: \"Manual\",\n          items: currentItems,\n          created_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n        }\n      : (this.snapshotsByScope.get(sourceScope) || []).slice(-1)[0] || {\n          id: \"snap-empty\",\n          source_scope: sourceScope,\n          trigger: \"Manual\",\n          items: [],\n          created_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n        };\n    return this.diff(sourceScope, ckpt, toSnap);\n  }\n}\n",

}

  "CodeContent": "/**\n * Holographic Reduced Representations (HRR) (§4.10)\n *\n * Ephemeral situational state binding and vector unbinding.\n */\n\nexport interface HRRVector {\n  values: number[];\n  dim: number;\n}\n\nexport class Codebook {\n  public symbols: Map<string, HRRVector> = new Map();\n  public dim: number;\n\n  constructor(dim: number = 512) {\n    this.dim = dim;\n  }\n\n  public getOrCreate(symbol: string): HRRVector {\n    let vec = this.symbols.get(symbol);\n    if (!vec) {\n      const vals: number[] = [];\n      const scale = 1.0 / Math.sqrt(this.dim);\n      let normSq = 0;\n      for (let i = 0; i < this.dim; i++) {\n        // Box-Muller approx or uniform normal\n        const u = Math.random();\n        const v = Math.random();\n        const z = Math.sqrt(-2.0 * Math.log(u || 1e-7)) * Math.cos(2.0 * Math.PI * v);\n        const val = z * scale;\n        vals.push(val);\n        normSq += val * val;\n      }\n      const norm = Math.sqrt(normSq) || 1.0;\n      const normalized = vals.map(v => v / norm);\n      vec = { values: normalized, dim: this.dim };\n      this.symbols.set(symbol, vec);\n    }\n    return vec;\n  }\n}\n\nexport function circularConvolution(a: number[], b: number[]): number[] {\n  const n = a.length;\n  const c = new Array(n).fill(0);\n  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n    for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {\n      const k = (i + j) % n;\n      c[k] += a[i] * b[j];\n    }\n  }\n  // Normalize\n  let normSq = 0;\n  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) normSq += c[i] * c[i];\n  const norm = Math.sqrt(normSq) || 1.0;\n  return c.map(v => v / norm);\n}\n\nexport function circularCorrelation(c: number[], b: number[]): number[] {\n  const n = b.length;\n  const bInv = new Array(n);\n  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n    bInv[i] = b[(n - i) % n];\n  }\n  return circularConvolution(c, bInv);\n}\n\nexport function cosineSimilarity(v1: number[], v2: number[]): number {\n  let dot = 0;\n  let n1Sq = 0;\n  let n2Sq = 0;\n  for (let i = 0; i < v1.length; i++) {\n    dot += v1[i] * v2[i];\n    n1Sq += v1[i] * v1[i];\n    n2Sq += v2[i] * v2[i];\n  }\n  const denom = Math.sqrt(n1Sq) * Math.sqrt(n2Sq);\n  return denom > 1e-12 ? dot / denom : 0;\n}\n\nexport class HolographicMemory {\n  private codebook: Codebook;\n  private storedStates: Map<string, HRRVector> = new Map();\n\n  constructor(dim: number = 512) {\n    this.codebook = new Codebook(dim);\n  }\n\n  public storeState(\n    stateId: string,\n    currentTask: string,\n    activeMode: string,\n    stressLevel: string\n  ): HRRVector {\n    const kTask = this.codebook.getOrCreate(\"KEY_TASK\");\n    const vTask = this.codebook.getOrCreate(`TASK:${currentTask}`);\n    const pairTask = circularConvolution(kTask.values, vTask.values);\n\n    const kMode = this.codebook.getOrCreate(\"KEY_MODE\");\n    const vMode = this.codebook.getOrCreate(`MODE:${activeMode}`);\n    const pairMode = circularConvolution(kMode.values, vMode.values);\n\n    const kStress = this.codebook.getOrCreate(\"KEY_STRESS\");\n    const vStress = this.codebook.getOrCreate(`STRESS:${stressLevel}`);\n    const pairStress = circularConvolution(kStress.values, vStress.values);\n\n    const n = kTask.dim;\n    const bundle = new Array(n).fill(0);\n    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n      bundle[i] = pairTask[i] + pairMode[i] + pairStress[i];\n    }\n    let normSq = 0;\n    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) normSq += bundle[i] * bundle[i];\n    const norm = Math.sqrt(normSq) || 1.0;\n    const finalVec: HRRVector = {\n      values: bundle.map(v => v / norm),\n      dim: n,\n    };\n    this.storedStates.set(stateId, finalVec);\n    return finalVec;\n  }\n\n  public queryStateAttribute(stateId: string, keyName: string): string | null {\n    const state = this.storedStates.get(stateId);\n    if (!state) return null;\n    const keyVec = this.codebook.getOrCreate(`KEY_${keyName.toUpperCase()}`);\n    const noisy = circularCorrelation(state.values, keyVec.values);\n\n    let bestSymbol: string | null = null;\n    let maxSim = -1.0;\n    for (const [sym, proto] of this.codebook.symbols.entries()) {\n      const sim = cosineSimilarity(noisy, proto.values);\n      if (sim > maxSim && sim >= 0.25) {\n        maxSim = sim;\n        bestSymbol = sym;\n      }\n    }\n    if (bestSymbol && bestSymbol.includes(\":\")) {\n      return bestSymbol.split(\":\")[1];\n    }\n    return bestSymbol;\n  }\n}\n",
  "Description": "Implement TypeScript HRR vector operations in locus-extension/src/providers/memory/hrr.ts",

  "CodeContent": "/**\n * STDP Reinforcement (Spike-Timing-Dependent Plasticity) (§4.12)\n *\n * Temporal asymmetric learning rule adjusting graph edge weights based on turn outcome.\n */\n\nexport const A_PLUS = 0.15;\nexport const A_MINUS = 0.12;\nexport const TAU_PLUS = 300.0;\nexport const TAU_MINUS = 600.0;\nexport const W_MIN = 0.05;\nexport const W_MAX = 1.00;\nexport const PRUNE_THRESHOLD = 0.08;\n\nexport interface RetrievalEvent {\n  node_id: string;\n  edge_id: string;\n  retrieved_at: number; // epoch ms\n}\n\nexport interface OutcomeEvent {\n  session_id: string;\n  turn_id: string;\n  success: boolean;\n  occurred_at: number; // epoch ms\n}\n\nexport interface TurnAuditLog {\n  session_id: string;\n  turn_id: string;\n  outcome: OutcomeEvent;\n  traversed_edges: RetrievalEvent[];\n}\n\nexport function clampWeight(w: number): number {\n  return Math.max(W_MIN, Math.min(W_MAX, w));\n}\n\nexport function applyStdpUpdate(\n  retrieval: RetrievalEvent,\n  outcome: OutcomeEvent,\n  currentWeight: number\n): number {\n  const deltaSeconds = (outcome.occurred_at - retrieval.retrieved_at) / 1000.0;\n  if (deltaSeconds <= 0) {\n    return clampWeight(currentWeight);\n  }\n\n  let newW = currentWeight;\n  if (outcome.success) {\n    const deltaW = A_PLUS * Math.exp(-deltaSeconds / TAU_PLUS);\n    newW = currentWeight + deltaW;\n  } else {\n    const deltaW = A_MINUS * Math.exp(-deltaSeconds / TAU_MINUS);\n    newW = currentWeight - deltaW;\n  }\n  return clampWeight(newW);\n}\n\nexport class STDPManager {\n  private edgeWeights: Map<string, number> = new Map();\n  private prunedEdges: Set<string> = new Set();\n  private defaultWeight: number;\n\n  constructor(defaultWeight: number = 0.50) {\n    this.defaultWeight = defaultWeight;\n  }\n\n  public getEdgeWeight(edgeId: string): number {\n    if (this.prunedEdges.has(edgeId)) return 0.0;\n    return this.edgeWeights.get(edgeId) ?? this.defaultWeight;\n  }\n\n  public setEdgeWeight(edgeId: string, weight: number): number {\n    const clamped = clampWeight(weight);\n    this.edgeWeights.set(edgeId, clamped);\n    if (clamped <= PRUNE_THRESHOLD) {\n      this.prunedEdges.add(edgeId);\n    } else {\n      this.prunedEdges.delete(edgeId);\n    }\n    return clamped;\n  }\n\n  public processTurn(turnAuditLog: TurnAuditLog): Map<string, number> {\n    const results = new Map<string, number>();\n    for (const ret of turnAuditLog.traversed_edges) {\n      const curW = this.getEdgeWeight(ret.edge_id);\n      const updatedW = applyStdpUpdate(ret, turnAuditLog.outcome, curW);\n      this.setEdgeWeight(ret.edge_id, updatedW);\n      results.set(ret.edge_id, updatedW);\n    }\n    return results;\n  }\n}\n",

{
  "CodeContent": "/**\n * Spaced Repetition Memory Consolidation (SM-2 / FSRS) (§4.13)\n *\n * Computes memory node review intervals and handles nightly consolidation queues.\n */\n\nexport const MIN_EASE_FACTOR = 1.30;\nexport const DEFAULT_EASE_FACTOR = 2.50;\n\nexport interface MemoryNodeState {\n  node_id: string;\n  repetition_count: number;\n  ease_factor: number;\n  interval_days: number;\n  stability: number;\n  last_reviewed_at?: string;\n  due_date?: string;\n}\n\nexport function calculateNextReview(\n  state: MemoryNodeState,\n  qualityGrade: number,\n  currentTime?: Date\n): MemoryNodeState {\n  const now = currentTime || new Date();\n  const grade = Math.max(0, Math.min(5, qualityGrade));\n\n  if (grade >= 3) {\n    if (state.repetition_count === 0) {\n      state.interval_days = 1;\n    } else if (state.repetition_count === 1) {\n      state.interval_days = 6;\n    } else {\n      state.interval_days = Math.max(1, Math.round(state.interval_days * state.ease_factor));\n    }\n    state.repetition_count += 1;\n  } else {\n    state.repetition_count = 0;\n    state.interval_days = 1;\n  }\n\n  const deltaEf = 0.1 - (5 - grade) * (0.08 + (5 - grade) * 0.02);\n  state.ease_factor = Math.max(MIN_EASE_FACTOR, state.ease_factor + deltaEf);\n\n  if (grade >= 3) {\n    state.stability = Math.round(state.stability * (1.0 + (grade - 2) * 0.2) * 1000) / 1000;\n  } else {\n    state.stability = Math.max(0.5, Math.round(state.stability * 0.6 * 1000) / 1000);\n  }\n\n  state.last_reviewed_at = now.toISOString();\n  const nextDate = new Date(now.getTime() + state.interval_days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);\n  state.due_date = nextDate.toISOString();\n  return state;\n}\n\nexport class MemoryScheduler {\n  private nodeStates: Map<string, MemoryNodeState> = new Map();\n\n  public registerNode(nodeId: string, easeFactor: number = DEFAULT_EASE_FACTOR): MemoryNodeState {\n    const now = new Date();\n    const state: MemoryNodeState = {\n      node_id: nodeId,\n      repetition_count: 0,\n      ease_factor: easeFactor,\n      interval_days: 1,\n      stability: 1.0,\n      due_date: now.toISOString(),\n    };\n    this.nodeStates.set(nodeId, state);\n    return state;\n  }\n\n  public recordReview(nodeId: string, grade: number): MemoryNodeState {\n    let state = this.nodeStates.get(nodeId);\n    if (!state) {\n      state = this.registerNode(nodeId);\n    }\n    const updated = calculateNextReview(state, grade);\n    this.nodeStates.set(nodeId, updated);\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  public getDueNodes(asOf?: Date): MemoryNodeState[] {\n    const targetIso = (asOf || new Date()).toISOString();\n    const dueList: MemoryNodeState[] = [];\n    for (const state of this.nodeStates.values()) {\n      if (!state.due_date || state.due_date <= targetIso) {\n        dueList.push(state);\n      }\n    }\n    return dueList.sort((a, b) => (a.due_date || \"\").localeCompare(b.due_date || \"\"));\n  }\n}\n",

calculate_retention_strength(project_state: str, days_since_last_touch: float) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Compute exponential half-life decay: S(t) = S_0 * 2^(-t / T_1/2).\"\"\"\n    if days_since_last_touch <= 0:\n        return 1.0\n    half_life = HALF_LIFE_DAYS.get(project_state.upper(), DEFAULT_HALF_LIFE)\n    strength = 1.0 * (2.0 ** (-days_since_last_touch / half_life))\n    return round(max(0.0, min(1.0, strength)), 4)\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass ProjectMemoryCluster:\n    project_id: str\n    status: str = \"ACTIVE\"\n    last_touched_at: str = field(\n   "CodeContent": "/**\n * Project-Specific Memory Decay Engine (§4.14)\n *\n * Status-based exponential memory retention and cold-storage transitions.\n */\n\nexport const HALF_LIFE_DAYS: Record<string, number> = {\n  ACTIVE: 90.0,\n  PAUSED: 30.0,\n  BACKLOG: 14.0,\n  ARCHIVED: 7.0,\n};\n\nexport const DEFAULT_HALF_LIFE = 30.0;\nexport const COLD_STORAGE_THRESHOLD = 0.10;\n\nexport function calculateRetentionStrength(projectState: string, daysSinceLastTouch: number): number {\n  if (daysSinceLastTouch <= 0) return 1.0;\n  const halfLife = HALF_LIFE_DAYS[projectState.toUpperCase()] ?? DEFAULT_HALF_LIFE;\n  const strength = 1.0 * Math.pow(2.0, -daysSinceLastTouch / halfLife);\n  return Math.round(Math.max(0.0, Math.min(1.0, strength)) * 10000) / 10000;\n}\n\nexport interface ProjectMemoryCluster {\n  project_id: string;\n  status: string;\n  last_touched_at: string;\n  nodes: Record<string, unknown>[];\n  retention_strength: number;\n  is_cold_archived: boolean;\n}\n\nexport class ProjectDecayManager {\n  private clusters: Map<string, ProjectMemoryCluster> = new Map();\n  private coldArchive: Map<string, Record<string, unknown>> = new Map();\n\n  public registerProject(\n    projectId: string,\n    status: string = \"ACTIVE\",\n    nodes: Record<string, unknown>[] = []\n  ): ProjectMemoryCluster {\n    const cluster: ProjectMemoryCluster = {\n      project_id: projectId,\n      status: status.toUpperCase(),\n      last_touched_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n      nodes,\n      retention_strength: 1.0,\n      is_cold_archived: false,\n    };\n    this.clusters.set(projectId, cluster);\n    return cluster;\n  }\n\n  public touchProject(projectId: string): ProjectMemoryCluster | null {\n    const cluster = this.clusters.get(projectId);\n    if (!cluster) return null;\n    cluster.last_touched_at = new Date().toISOString();\n    cluster.retention_strength = 1.0;\n    if (cluster.is_cold_archived) {\n      cluster.is_cold_archived = false;\n      this.coldArchive.delete(projectId);\n    }\n    return cluster;\n  }\n\n  public sweepProjectMemories(currentTime?: Date): { total_swept: number; newly_archived: number } {\n    const now = currentTime || new Date();\n    let swept = 0;\n    let newlyArchived = 0;\n\n    for (const cluster of this.clusters.values()) {\n      const lt = new Date(cluster.last_touched_at).getTime();\n      const daysInactive = Math.max(0, (now.getTime() - lt) / (1000 * 86400));\n      const strength = calculateRetentionStrength(cluster.status, daysInactive);\n      cluster.retention_strength = strength;\n      swept++;\n\n      if (strength < COLD_STORAGE_THRESHOLD && !cluster.is_cold_archived) {\n        cluster.is_cold_archived = true;\n        this.coldArchive.set(cluster.project_id, {\n          project_id: cluster.project_id,\n          archived_at: now.toISOString(),\n          cluster,\n        });\n        newlyArchived++;\n      }\n    }\n\n    return { total_swept: swept, newly_archived: newlyArchived };\n  }\n}\n",
  "Description": "Implement TypeScript Project Memory Decay in locus-extension/src/providers/memory/project-decay.ts",

}

{
  "CodeContent": "/**\n * Context Compression Engine (§4.16)\n *\n * Hermes-style threshold monitoring and conversation history compaction.\n */\n\nexport interface Message {\n  role: string;\n  content: string;\n  [key: string]: unknown;\n}\n\nexport interface ContextEngineOptions {\n  name?: string;\n  contextLength?: number;\n  thresholdPercent?: number;\n  protectFirstN?: number;\n  protectLastN?: number;\n}\n\nexport class ContextEngine {\n  public name: string;\n  public contextLength: number;\n  public thresholdPercent: number;\n  public protectFirstN: number;\n  public protectLastN: number;\n  public thresholdTokens: number;\n  public lastPromptTokens: number = 0;\n  public compressionCount: number = 0;\n\n  constructor(options: ContextEngineOptions = {}) {\n    this.name = options.name ?? \"hermes_compressor\";\n    this.contextLength = options.contextLength ?? 128000;\n    this.thresholdPercent = options.thresholdPercent ?? 0.75;\n    this.protectFirstN = options.protectFirstN ?? 3;\n    this.protectLastN = options.protectLastN ?? 6;\n    this.thresholdTokens = Math.floor(this.contextLength * this.thresholdPercent);\n  }\n\n  public shouldCompress(promptTokens?: number): boolean {\n    const tokens = promptTokens ?? this.lastPromptTokens;\n    return tokens >= this.thresholdTokens;\n  }\n\n  public compress(\n    messages: Message[],\n    focusTopic?: string,\n    summarizerFn?: (middle: Message[], focus?: string) => string\n  ): Message[] {\n    const headCount = this.protectFirstN + 1; // system + first N\n    const tailCount = this.protectLastN;\n\n    if (messages.length <= headCount + tailCount) {\n      return [...messages];\n    }\n\n    const head = messages.slice(0, headCount);\n    const tail = messages.slice(-tailCount);\n    const middle = messages.slice(headCount, -tailCount);\n\n    if (middle.length === 0) {\n      return [...messages];\n    }\n\n    let summaryText = \"\";\n    if (summarizerFn) {\n      summaryText = summarizerFn(middle, focusTopic);\n    } else {\n      const snippets = middle\n        .slice(0, 8)\n        .map(m => `[${m.role}]: ${m.content.slice(0, 80)}`)\n        .join(\"\\n\");\n      summaryText = `Compressed history (${middle.length} messages):\\n${snippets}`;\n    }\n\n    if (focusTopic) {\n      summaryText += `\\n[Focus Topic: ${focusTopic}]`;\n    }\n\n    const summaryMessage: Message = {\n      role: \"system\",\n      content: `[Previous context summary]: ${summaryText}`,\n      compressed: true,\n    };\n\n    this.compressionCount++;\n    return [...head, summaryMessage, ...tail];\n  }\n}\n",

{
  "CodeContent": "\"\"\"Token Compression (Headroom CCR - Cache-Compress-Retrieve) (§4.17).\n\nReversible multi-format compression pipeline for LLM contexts:\nCacheAligner -> ContentRouter -> [SmartCrusher (JSON) | CodeCompressor | TextCompressor] -> CCR Cache.\nIncludes inflation guard and prompt cache prefix stabilization.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport re\nimport time\nimport uuid\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass CompressConfig:\n    protect_recent: int = 4\n    min_tokens_to_compress: int = 250\n    compress_user_messages: bool = False\n    target_ratio: float = 0.50\n    frozen_message_count: int = 1  # Preserve prefix for provider KV cache\n    cache_ttl_seconds: int = 3600\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass CompressResult:\n    compressed_messages: List[Dict[str, Any]]\n    original_token_estimate: int\n    compressed_token_estimate: int\n    compression_ratio: float\n    cache_keys_created: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        return asdict(self)\n\n\ndef estimate_tokens(text: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Fast conservative token estimator: ~4 characters per token.\"\"\"\n    return max(1, len(text) // 4)\n\n\nclass CCRCache:\n    \"\"\"Local key-value cache for reversible retrieval of compressed chunks.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, default_ttl: int = 3600) -> None:\n        self.default_ttl = default_ttl\n        self._cache: Dict[str, Tuple[str, float]] = {}  # key -> (original_text, expire_at)\n\n    def put(self, original_text: str, ttl: Optional[int] = None) -> str:\n        key = \"ccr_\" + hashlib.sha256(original_text.encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest()[:16]\n        expire_at = time.time() + (ttl or self.default_ttl)\n        self._cache[key] = (original_text, expire_at)\n        return key\n\n    def get(self, key: str) -> Optional[str]:\n        entry = self._cache.get(key)\n        if not entry:\n            return None\n        text, expire_at = entry\n        if time.time() > expire_at:\n            self._cache.pop(key, None)\n            return None\n        return text\n\n\nclass SmartCrusher:\n    \"\"\"JSON compressor: deduplicates array items and removes unnecessary whitespace.\"\"\"\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def compress(text: str) -> str:\n        try:\n            parsed = json.loads(text)\n            if isinstance(parsed, list) and len(parsed) > 5:\n                # Deduplicate array entries if string or simple dict\n                seen = []\n                for item in parsed:\n                    if item not in seen:\n                        seen.append(item)\n                compact = json.dumps(seen, separators=(\",\", \":\"))\n                return compact\n            elif isinstance(parsed, dict):\n                return json.dumps(parsed, separators=(\",\", \":\"))\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n        return text\n\n\nclass CodeCompressor:\n    \"\"\"Code compressor: strips redundant blank lines, docstring padding, and structural bloat.\"\"\"\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def compress(code: str) -> str:\n        # Collapse multiple empty lines to one\n        cleaned = re.sub(r\"\\n\\s*\\n+\", \"\\n\\n\", code)\n        # Strip trailing whitespaces\n        cleaned = \"\\n\".join(line.rstrip() for line in cleaned.splitlines())\n        return cleaned\n\n\nclass TextCompressor:\n    \"\"\"Prose compressor: collapses whitespace repetitions.\"\"\"\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def compress(text: str) -> str:\n        return re.sub(r\"[ \\t]+\", \" \", text).strip()\n\n\nclass HeadroomCompressor:\n    \"\"\"Unified Headroom CCR compression engine.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, config: Optional[CompressConfig] = None) -> None:\n        self.config = config or CompressConfig()\n        self.cache = CCRCache(default_ttl=self.config.cache_ttl_seconds)\n\n    def _route_and_compress_content(self, content: str) -> Tuple[str, Optional[str]]:\n        trimmed = content.strip()\n        # Route JSON\n        if (trimmed.startswith(\"{\") and trimmed.endswith(\"}\")) or (trimmed.startswith(\"[\") and trimmed.endswith(\"]\")):\n            compressed = SmartCrusher.compress(trimmed)\n        # Route Code (contains def, class, import, function, etc.)\n        elif re.search(r\"^\\s*(def |class |import |export |function )\", trimmed, re.MULTILINE):\n            compressed = CodeCompressor.compress(trimmed)\n        else:\n            compressed = TextCompressor.compress(trimmed)\n\n        # Reversible CCR cache hook if significant compression achieved\n        cache_key = None\n        if len(compressed) < len(content) * 0.8:\n            cache_key = self.cache.put(content)\n            compressed = f\"{compressed}\\n[CCR_RETRIEVAL_KEY: {cache_key}]\"\n\n        return compressed, cache_key\n\n    def compress(\n        self,\n        messages: List[Dict[str, Any]],\n        model: str = \"default\",\n    ) -> CompressResult:\n        if not messages:\n            return CompressResult([], 0, 0, 1.0, [])\n\n        total_orig_tokens = sum(estimate_tokens(str(m.get(\"content\", \"\"))) for m in messages)\n        cfg = self.config\n\n        # 1. CacheAligner: protect frozen prefix\n        frozen_count = min(cfg.frozen_message_count, len(messages))\n        frozen_prefix = messages[:frozen_count]\n\n        # 2. Protect recent messages\n        protect_count = cfg.protect_recent\n        compressible_limit = max(frozen_count, len(messages) - protect_count)\n\n        compressible_slice = messages[frozen_count:compressible_limit]\n        recent_suffix = messages[compressible_limit:]\n\n        processed_compressible: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []\n        cache_keys: List[str] = []\n\n        for msg in compressible_slice:\n            role = msg.get(\"role\", \"\")\n            content = str(msg.get(\"content\", \"\"))\n            tokens = estimate_tokens(content)\n\n            # Skip user messages if configured\n            if role == \"user\" and not cfg.compress_user_messages:\n                processed_compressible.append(msg)\n                continue\n\n            # Skip messages below minimum token threshold\n            if tokens < cfg.min_tokens_to_compress:\n                processed_compressible.append(msg)\n                continue\n\n            compressed_text, c_key = self._route_and_compress_content(content)\n\n            # Inflation Guard: if compression made it larger, revert!\n            if estimate_tokens(compressed_text) >= tokens:\n                processed_compressible.append(msg)\n            else:\n                new_msg = dict(msg)\n                new_msg[\"content\"] = compressed_text\n                new_msg[\"headroom_compressed\"] = True\n                processed_compressible.append(new_msg)\n                if c_key:\n                    cache_keys.append(c_key)\n\n        final_messages = frozen_prefix + processed_compressible + recent_suffix\n        total_comp_tokens = sum(estimate_tokens(str(m.get(\"content\", \"\"))) for m in final_messages)\n        ratio = round(total_comp_tokens / max(1, total_orig_tokens), 4)\n\n        return CompressResult(\n            compressed_messages=final_messages,\n            original_token_estimate=total_orig_tokens,\n            compressed_token_estimate=total_comp_tokens,\n            compression_ratio=ratio,\n            cache_keys_created=cache_keys,\n        )\n\n    def retrieve(self, cache_key: str) -> Optional[str]:\n        return self.cache.get(cache_key)\n\n\ndef compress(\n    messages: List[Dict[str, Any]],\n    model: str = \"default\",\n    config: Optional[CompressConfig] = None,\n) -> CompressResult:\n    engine = HeadroomCompressor(config=config)\n    return engine.compress(messages=messages, model=model)\n",

{
  "CodeContent": "/**\n * Token Compression (Headroom CCR - Cache-Compress-Retrieve) (§4.17)\n *\n * Content-routed token compression with cache prefix alignment and reversible CCR lookup.\n */\n\nexport interface CompressConfig {\n  protect_recent?: number;\n  min_tokens_to_compress?: number;\n  compress_user_messages?: boolean;\n  target_ratio?: number;\n  frozen_message_count?: number;\n  cache_ttl_seconds?: number;\n}\n\nexport interface CompressResult {\n  compressed_messages: Record<string, unknown>[];\n  original_token_estimate: number;\n  compressed_token_estimate: number;\n  compression_ratio: number;\n  cache_keys_created: string[];\n}\n\nexport class CCRCache {\n  private cache: Map<string, { text: string; expireAt: number }> = new Map();\n  private defaultTtl: number;\n\n  constructor(defaultTtl: number = 3600) {\n    this.defaultTtl = defaultTtl;\n  }\n\n  public put(text: string, ttl?: number): string {\n    const key = \"ccr_\" + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 10);\n    const expireAt = Date.now() + (ttl || this.defaultTtl) * 1000;\n    this.cache.set(key, { text, expireAt });\n    return key;\n  }\n\n  public get(key: string): string | null {\n    const entry = this.cache.get(key);\n    if (!entry) return null;\n    if (Date.now() > entry.expireAt) {\n      this.cache.delete(key);\n      return null;\n    }\n    return entry.text;\n  }\n}\n\nexport class HeadroomCompressor {\n  private config: Required<CompressConfig>;\n  private cache: CCRCache;\n\n  constructor(config: CompressConfig = {}) {\n    this.config = {\n      protect_recent: config.protect_recent ?? 4,\n      min_tokens_to_compress: config.min_tokens_to_compress ?? 250,\n      compress_user_messages: config.compress_user_messages ?? false,\n      target_ratio: config.target_ratio ?? 0.50,\n      frozen_message_count: config.frozen_message_count ?? 1,\n      cache_ttl_seconds: config.cache_ttl_seconds ?? 3600,\n    };\n    this.cache = new CCRCache(this.config.cache_ttl_seconds);\n  }\n\n  public compress(messages: Record<string, unknown>[]): CompressResult {\n    const origTokens = messages.reduce(\n      (acc, m) => acc + Math.max(1, Math.floor(String(m.content || \"\").length / 4)),\n      0\n    );\n\n    const frozenCount = Math.min(this.config.frozen_message_count, messages.length);\n    const frozen = messages.slice(0, frozenCount);\n    const protectLimit = Math.max(frozenCount, messages.length - this.config.protect_recent);\n    const middle = messages.slice(frozenCount, protectLimit);\n    const recent = messages.slice(protectLimit);\n\n    const processedMiddle: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];\n    const cacheKeys: string[] = [];\n\n    for (const msg of middle) {\n      const content = String(msg.content || \"\");\n      const tokens = Math.max(1, Math.floor(content.length / 4));\n\n      if (msg.role === \"user\" && !this.config.compress_user_messages) {\n        processedMiddle.push(msg);\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      if (tokens < this.config.min_tokens_to_compress) {\n        processedMiddle.push(msg);\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      // Compact whitespace / redundant spacing\n      const compacted = content.replace(/\\n\\s*\\n+/g, \"\\n\\n\").trim();\n      if (Math.floor(compacted.length / 4) < tokens * 0.8) {\n        const cKey = this.cache.put(content);\n        cacheKeys.push(cKey);\n        processedMiddle.push({\n          ...msg,\n          content: `${compacted}\\n[CCR_RETRIEVAL_KEY: ${cKey}]`,\n          headroom_compressed: true,\n        });\n      } else {\n        processedMiddle.push(msg);\n      }\n    }\n\n    const finalMessages = [...frozen, ...processedMiddle, ...recent];\n    const compTokens = finalMessages.reduce(\n      (acc, m) => acc + Math.max(1, Math.floor(String(m.content || \"\").length / 4)),\n      0\n    );\n    const ratio = Math.round((compTokens / Math.max(1, origTokens)) * 10000) / 10000;\n\n    return {\n      compressed_messages: finalMessages,\n      original_token_estimate: origTokens,\n      compressed_token_estimate: compTokens,\n      compression_ratio: ratio,\n      cache_keys_created: cacheKeys,\n    };\n  }\n\n  public retrieve(cacheKey: string): string | null {\n    return this.cache.get(cacheKey);\n  }\n}\n",

Long JSON with repeated elements and formatting whitespace\n    data = [{\"id\": i, \"val\": \"item\"} for i in range(10)]\n    pretty = json.dumps(data, indent=4)\n    crushed = SmartCrusher.compress(pretty)\n    assert len(crushed) < len(pretty)\n    # Valid json check\n    assert json.loads(crushed) == data\n\n\ndef test_code_compressor_redundant_newlines():\n    code = \"\"\"\ndef my_func():\n\n    \n    print('hello')\n\n\n\n    return True\n\"\"\"\n    cleaned = CodeCompressor.compress(code)\n    assert \"\\n\\n\\n\" not in cleaned\n    assert \"print('hello')\" in cleaned\n\n\ndef test_ccr_cache_and_reversible_retrieval():\n    cache = CCRCache(default_ttl=10)\n    original = \"This is a detailed payload that was compressed.\"\n    key = cache.put(original)\n    assert key.startswith(\"ccr_\")\n    assert cache.get(key) == original\n    assert cache.get(\"non_existent\") is None\n\n\ndef test_headroom_compressor_pipeline():\n    cfg = CompressConfig(\n        protect_recent=2,\n        min_tokens_to_compress=50,\n        frozen_message_count=1,\n    )\n    long_content = \"def calculate():\\n\\n\\n    x = 10\\n\\n\\n    return x\\n\" * 20\n    messages = [\n        {\"role\": \"system\", \"content\": \"You are Locus OS.\"},\n        {\"role\": \"assistant\", \"content\": long_content},\n        {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": \"Recent question?\"},\n        {\"role\": \"assistant\", \"content\": \"Recent response.\"},\n    ]\n\n    result = compress(messages, config=cfg)\n    assert len(result.compressed_messages) == 4\n    assert result.compressed_token_estimate < result.original_token_estimate\n    assert result.compression_ratio < 1.0\n\n    # System message (frozen) is untouched\n    assert result.compressed_messages[0][\"content\"] == \"You are Locus OS.\"\n    # Compressible middle message is compressed\n    assert result.compressed_messages[1].get(\"headroom_compressed\") is True\n    # Recent suffix messages are untouched\n    assert result.compressed_messages[2][\"content\"] == \"Recent question?\"\n    assert result.compressed_messages[3][\"content\"] == \"Recent response.\"\n",

# Feature §1.2: System Prompt Construction



### Source

### Stripped Logic (Pseudocode)



```

FUNCTION buildSystemPrompt(options):

    // Resolve CWD with forward slashes

    promptCwd = options.cwd.replace("\\", "/")

    date = formatDate(now())



    IF options.customPrompt:

        prompt = options.customPrompt

        // Append extra text

        IF options.appendSystemPrompt:

            prompt += options.appendSystemPrompt

        // Append project context files (AGENTS.md, etc.)

        IF options.contextFiles.length > 0:

            prompt += "<project_context>"

            FOR EACH { path, content } IN options.contextFiles:

                prompt += "<project_instructions path='{path}'>{content}</project_instructions>"

            prompt += "</project_context>"

        // Append skills section (only if read tool available)

        IF "read" tool available AND options.skills.length > 0:

            prompt += formatSkillsForPrompt(options.skills)

        prompt += "Current date: {date}"

        prompt += "Current working directory: {promptCwd}"

        RETURN prompt



    // Default prompt construction

    tools = options.selectedTools OR ["read", "bash", "edit", "write"]

    toolsList = tools.filter(has snippet).map(t => "- {t}: {snippet}")



    // Build guidelines dynamically based on available tools

    guidelines = []

    IF has bash but no grep/find/ls:

        guidelines.add("Use bash for file operations like ls, rg, find")

    guidelines.addAll(options.promptGuidelines)

    guidelines.add("Be concise in your responses")

    guidelines.add("Show file paths clearly when working with files")



    prompt = "You are an expert coding assistant operating inside pi..."

    prompt += toolsList + guidelines

    prompt += documentation paths

    prompt += appendSection + contextFiles + skills + date + cwd

    RETURN prompt

```

  "CodeContent": "/**\n * Model Management & Escalation Hook (§1.4).\n *\n * Bridges Pi Agent's prepareNextTurn hook to Locus ModelRouter.\n * Automatically escalates from standard turn models (DeepSeek Flash) to complex reasoning\n * models (Gemini Pro) when task classification or context demands it.\n */\n\nimport { ModelRouter, RoutingDecision, TaskCategory } from \"./routing/model-router.js\";\n\nexport interface TurnEscalationContext {\n  turn_count: number;\n  last_user_prompt: string;\n  accumulated_tokens: number;\n  active_mode?: string;\n}\n\nexport class ModelEscalationManager {\n  private router: ModelRouter;\n\n  constructor() {\n    this.router = new ModelRouter();\n  }\n\n  public evaluateEscalation(context: TurnEscalationContext): RoutingDecision {\n    // If user prompt triggers complex reasoning or context is deep\n    const category: TaskCategory =\n      context.accumulated_tokens > 64000 || /architect|synthesis|complex|refactor/i.test(context.last_user_prompt)\n        ? \"complex_reasoning\"\n        : \"standard_chat\";\n\n    return this.router.route(category, {\n      estimated_tokens: context.accumulated_tokens,\n    });\n  }\n}\n",

{
  "CodeContent": "\"\"\"Extension Lifecycle Engine (§1.5).\n\nCoordinates 25+ lifecycle events connecting Pi Agent turn cycles\nwith sidecar memory flushes, state calculations, and tool audits.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport asyncio\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\nfrom typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional\n\n\nLIFECYCLE_EVENTS: List[str] = [\n    \"session_start\",\n    \"turn_start\",\n    \"message_start\",\n    \"message_update\",\n    \"message_end\",\n    \"tool_execution_start\",\n    \"tool_execution_update\",\n    \"tool_execution_end\",\n    \"turn_end\",\n    \"agent_end\",\n    \"session_shutdown\",\n    \"before_compact\",\n    \"after_compact\",\n    \"before_tree\",\n    \"session_switch\",\n    \"replaced_session\",\n    \"context_usage_update\",\n    \"subagent_spawn\",\n    \"subagent_terminate\",\n    \"model_switch\",\n    \"quota_exceeded\",\n    \"approval_requested\",\n    \"approval_granted\",\n    \"approval_rejected\",\n    \"error\",\n]\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass LifecycleEvent:\n    event_type: str\n    session_id: str\n    turn_id: Optional[str] = None\n    timestamp: str = field(\n        default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()\n    )\n    data: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)\n\n\nclass LifecycleManager:\n    \"\"\"Dispatches lifecycle events across cognitive subsystems.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        self.listeners: Dict[str, List[Callable[[LifecycleEvent], Any]]] = {}\n        self.history: List[LifecycleEvent] = []\n\n    def subscribe(self, event_type: str, handler: Callable[[LifecycleEvent], Any]) -> None:\n        if event_type not in LIFECYCLE_EVENTS:\n            raise ValueError(f\"Unknown event type: {event_type}\")\n        self.listeners.setdefault(event_type, []).append(handler)\n\n    def dispatch(self, event: LifecycleEvent) -> None:\n        self.history.append(event)\n        for handler in self.listeners.get(event.event_type, []):\n            handler(event)\n\n    def get_event_history(self, event_type: Optional[str] = None) -> List[LifecycleEvent]:\n        if event_type:\n            return [e for e in self.history if e.event_type == event_type]\n        return list(self.history)\n",

# Feature §1.6: Context Window Management



**Status**: complete  

**Verdict**: 🔄 AUGMENT (Pi compaction + Locus Headroom CCR)



### Source(s) mined

- **Codebase**: Pi at `pi/packages/coding-agent/src/core/compaction/`

- **Files involved**: `compaction/index.ts` (compaction engine), `types.ts` (CompactionResult)

- **Query method**: [✅ VERIFIED: direct file read (/graphify unavailable)] — `/graphify` graph exists for future re-mining



### Logic extracted



```

CONTEXT WINDOW MANAGEMENT:

    estimateContextTokens(messages) → rough count

    shouldCompact(promptTokens, threshold) → bool

    compact(messages, options) → CompactionResult

    

    Compaction preserves:

    - protect_first_n = 3 (first 3 non-system messages)

    - protect_last_n = 6 (last 6 messages)

    - Everything between is summarized by auxiliary LLM call

```



### Locus adaptation



- **Component**: Locus replaces Pi's default compaction with Headroom CCR (§4.17) + its own 800-token budget enforcement in `transformContext`. Pi's compaction remains available as a `CompactionProvider` option.

- **Repo vs `.locus`**: compaction/compression adapters in `locus-os` (repo); Headroom CCR cache dir in `.locus/headroom_cache/` (runtime state).

- **Swappable / off state**: `locus.compaction.provider` (`headroom-ccr` | `pi-default` | `simple-summarize`). Off → raw message history grows unbounded until the LLM's context limit is hit.

- **Integration point**: invoked at Stage 5 (before Context Forge) and as session-level compaction.

{
  "CodeContent": "/**\n * Context Window Management (§1.6)\n *\n * Compaction adapter and token estimation for session history.\n */\n\nimport { HeadroomCompressor } from \"./providers/memory/headroom-ccr.js\";\n\nexport interface CompactionOptions {\n  protect_first_n?: number;\n  protect_last_n?: number;\n  threshold_tokens?: number;\n}\n\nexport function estimateContextTokens(messages: Array<{ content?: string }>): number {\n  return messages.reduce((acc, m) => acc + Math.max(1, Math.floor(String(m.content || \"\").length / 4)), 0);\n}\n\nexport function shouldCompact(promptTokens: number, thresholdTokens: number): boolean {\n  return promptTokens >= thresholdTokens;\n}\n\nexport class HeadroomCompactionAdapter {\n  private compressor: HeadroomCompressor;\n\n  constructor() {\n    this.compressor = new HeadroomCompressor();\n  }\n\n  public estimateTokens(messages: Array<{ content?: string }>): number {\n    return estimateContextTokens(messages);\n  }\n\n  public shouldCompact(promptTokens: number, threshold: number = 64000): boolean {\n    return shouldCompact(promptTokens, threshold);\n  }\n\n  public compact(messages: Record<string, unknown>[], options: CompactionOptions = {}) {\n    return this.compressor.compress(messages);\n  }\n}\n",
  "Description": "Implement TypeScript Context Window Management in locus-extension/src/context-window.ts",

FUNCTION spawn_background_review(parent_agent, conversation_snapshot):

    // CRITICAL: This runs on a DAEMON THREAD, never blocks the main loop

    

    // Step 1: Fork the parent agent's runtime

    forked_agent = fork_agent(

        parent_runtime = parent_agent.runtime,  // same provider, model, credentials

        conversation = conversation_snapshot,     // copy of messages so far

        tool_whitelist = ["memory", "skill_manage"],  // ONLY these tools allowed

        session_id = generate_new_session_id(),  // separate session

        skip_memory = true,   // don't recursively trigger memory writes

        skip_review = true    // don't recursively trigger review

    )

    

    // Step 2: Build review prompt

    review_prompt = MEMORY_REVIEW_PROMPT + SKILL_REVIEW_PROMPT

    // Memory review: "Has the user revealed preferences, personal details?"

    // Skill review: "Should any skill be saved/updated/patched?"

    

    // Step 3: Execute forked agent with review prompt

    // The forked agent reads the conversation, decides if memories/skills

    // need saving, and writes them directly to the stores

    thread = daemon_thread(target=forked_agent.run, args=[review_prompt])

    thread.start()

    // Thread runs in background. Main conversation continues immediately.

    

    // Step 4: The forked agent uses the auxiliary client (secondary LLM)

    // to avoid contesting the main model's prompt cache

    // It inherits the parent's cached system prompt prefix for efficiency



TOOL WHITELIST ENFORCEMENT:

    forked_agent.tool_filter = lambda tool_name:

        tool_name IN ["memory", "skill_manage"]

    // All other tools (terminal, write_file, browser, etc.) are DENIED

    // This prevents the review agent from side-effecting the filesystem



SKILL REVIEW PREFERENCE ORDER:

    1. UPDATE A C

        remaining: int          // e.g. 45 remaining

        reset_seconds: float    // seconds until window resets

        captured_at: float      // timestamp of capture

        

        COMPUTED: used = max(0, limit - remaining)

        COMPUTED: usage_pct = (used / limit) * 100

        COMPUTED: remaining_seconds_now = max(0, reset_seconds - (now - captured_at))

    

    RateLimitState:

        requests_min: RateLimitBucket    // RPM

        requests_hour: RateLimitBucket   // RPH

        tokens_min: RateLimitBucket      // TPM

self.remaining)\n\n    @property\n    def usage_pct(self) -> float:\n        if self.limit <= 0:\n            return 0.0\n        return round((self.used / self.limit) * 100.0, 2)\n\n    def remaining_seconds_now(self) -> float:\n        elapsed = time.time() - self.captured_at\n        return max(0.0, self.reset_seconds - elapsed)\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass RateLimitState:\n    provider: str = \"generic\"\n    requests_min: RateLimitBucket = field(default_factory=RateLimitBucket)\n    requests_hour: RateLimitBucket = field(default_factory=RateLimitBucket)\n    tokens_min: RateLimitBucket = field(default_factory=RateLimitBucket)\n    tokens_hour: RateLimitBucket = field(default_factory=RateLimitBucket)\n\n\ndef _safe_int(val: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:\n    try:\n        return int(val)\n    except (ValueError, TypeError):\n        return default\n\n\ndef _safe_float(val: Any, default: float = 0.0) -> float:\n    try:\n        return float(val)\n    except (ValueError, TypeError):\n        return default\n\n\nclass RateLimitTracker:\n    \"\"\"Tracks rate limits per provider and provides preemptive pause checks.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        self.states_by_provider: Dict[str, RateLimitState] = {}\n\n    def get_state(self, provider: str = \"generic\") -> RateLimitState:\n        if provider not in self.states_by_provider:\n            self.states_by_provider[provider] = RateLimitState(provider=provider)\n        return self.states_by_provider[provider]\n\n    def update_from_headers(self, headers: Dict[str, str], provider: str = \"generic\") -> RateLimitState:\n        # Standardize header keys to lowercase\n        norm_headers = {k.lower(): v for k, v in headers.items()}\n        state = self.get_state(provider)\n        now = time.time()\n\n        # 1. TPH (Tokens per hour)\n        tph_limit = _safe_int(norm_headers.get(\"x-ratelimit-limit-tokens-1h\"))\n        tph_rem = _safe_int(norm_headers.get(\"x-ratelimit-remaining-tokens-1h\"))\n        tph_reset = _safe_float(norm_headers.get(\"x-ratelimit-reset-tokens-1h\"))\n        if tph_limit > 0:\n            state.tokens_hour = RateLimitBucket(tph_limit, tph_rem, tph_reset, now)\n\n        return state\n\n    def should_pause(self, provider: str = \"generic\", min_remaining_requests: int = 2) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"True if any active bucket is exhausted below safety threshold.\"\"\"\n        state = self.get_state(provider)\n        if state.requests_min.limit > 0 and state.requests_min.remaining < min_remaining_requests:\n            if state.requests_min.remaining_seconds_now() > 0:\n                return True\n        if state.tokens_min.limit > 0 and state.tokens_min.remaining < 500:\n            if state.tokens_min.remaining_seconds_now() > 0:\n                return True\n        return False\n\n    def format_summary(self, provider: str = \"generic\") -> str:\n        state = self.get_state(provider)\n        parts = [f\"Provider: {provider}\"]\n        if state.requests_min.limit > 0:\n            parts.append(f\"RPM: {state.requests_min.remaining}/{state.requests_min.limit} ({state.requests_min.usage_pct}% used)\")\n        if state.tokens_min.limit > 0:\n            parts.append(f\"TPM: {state.tokens_min.remaining}/{state.tokens_min.limit} ({state.tokens_min.usage_pct}% used)\")\n        return \" | \".join(parts)\n",

RateLimitBucket;\n}\n\nexport class RateLimitTracker {\n  private statesByProvider: Map<string, RateLimitState> = new Map();\n\n  public updateFromHeaders(headers: Record<string, string>, provider: string = \"generic\"): RateLimitState {\n    const norm: Record<string, string> = {};\n    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(headers)) {\n      norm[k.toLowerCase()] = v;\n    }\n    const state: parseFloat(norm[\"x-ratelimit-reset-tokens\"] || \"0\");\n    if (tpmLimit > 0) {\n      state.tokens_min = {\n        limit: tpmLimit,\n        remaining: tpmRem,\n        reset_seconds: tpmReset,\n        captured_at: Date.now(),\n      };\n    }\n\n    this.statesByProvider.set(provider, state);\n    return state;\n  }\n\n  public shouldPause(provider: string = \"generic\", minRemaining: number   "CodeContent": "\"\"\"Title Generation Engine (§1.11).\n\nAuto-generates concise 3-7 word session titles from early conversational exchanges,\nfeaturing artifact cleanup and heuristic fallbacks.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional\n\n\nTITLE_PROMPT: str = (\n    \"Generate a short, descriptive title (3-7 words) for a conversation \"\n    \"that starts with the following exchange. Return ONLY the title text, \"\n    \"nothing else. No quotes, no punctuation at the end, no prefixes.\"\n)\n\n\ndef clean_title(raw_title: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Strip quotes, leading 'Title:', and trailing punctuation.\"\"\"\n    t = raw_title.strip()\n    # Strip quotes\n    if (t.startswith('\"') and t.endswith('\"')) or (t.startswith(\"'\") and t.endswith(\"'\")):\n        t = t[1:-1].strip()\n    # Strip leading prefixes\n    if t.lower().startswith(\"title:\"):\n        t = t[6:].strip()\n    # Strip trailing punctuation\n    t = t.rstrip(\".!?;:\")\n    # Clamp length\n    if len(t) > 80:\n        t = t[:77] + \"...\"\n    return t\n\n\ndef fallback_title(user_message: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Generate deterministic heuristic fallback title (first 4-6 words).\"\"\"\n    words = re.findall(r\"\\w+\", user_message)\n    if not words:\n        return \"New Session\"\n    selected = words[:min(6, len(words))]\n    return \" \".join(selected).capitalize()\n\n\nclass TitleGenerator:\n    \"\"\"Generates session titles asynchronously or synchronously using LLM / fallbacks.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, llm_caller: Optional[Callable[[List[Dict[str, str]]], str]] = None) -> None:\n        self.llm_caller = llm_caller\n\n    def generate_title(\n        self,\n        user_message: str,\n        assistant_response: str = \"\",\n        timeout: float = 10.0,\n    ) -> str:\n        if not self.llm_caller:\n            return fallback_title(user_message)\n\n        u_snip = user_message[:500]\n        a_snip = assistant_response[:500]\n        messages = [\n            {\"role\": \"system\", \"content\": TITLE_PROMPT},\n            {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": f\"User: {u_snip}\\n\\nAssistant: {a_snip}\"},\n        ]\n\n        try:\n            raw = self.llm_caller(messages)\n            cleaned = clean_title(raw)\n            return cleaned if cleaned else fallback_title(user_message)\n        except Exception:\n            return fallback_title(user_message)\n",

# Feature §5.1-5.8: Session Management & Telegram Bridge



### Source

- **Codebase**: Pi at `pi/packages/coding-agent/src/core/session-manager.ts`, `compaction/`

### Stripped Logic (Pseudocode)



```

SESSION FORMAT (JSONL v3):

    Entry types: message, tool_call, tool_result, compaction_summary,

                 branch_summary, metadata, system_event, checkpoint, marker



    Structure: tree-based (sessions can fork into branches)

    Storage: one .jsonl file per session, named by session_id



SESSION BRANCHING:

    FUNCTION fork_session(parent_session_id, fork_point):

        new_session = create_session()

        new_session.parent = parent_session_id

        new_session.fork_point = fork_point

        // Copy all entries up to fork_point

        copy_entries(parent_session_id, new_session.id, up_to=fork_point)

        // Branch summary entry marks the divergence point

        new_session.append(BranchSummaryEntry {

            parent: parent_session_id,

            fork_point: fork_point,

            summary: generate_branch_summary(entries_before_fork)

        })

        RETURN new_session



SESSION RESUME:

    FUNCTION resume_session(session_id):

        session = load_session(session_id)

        // Restore full message history

        messages = session.replay_entries()

        // Restore compacted summaries

        compactions = session.get_compaction_entries()

        // Rebuild context: summaries first, then recent messages

        context = rebuild_context(compactions, messages)

        RETURN context



TELEGRAM SESSION BRIDGE (Locus-unique):

    FUNCTION bridge_telegram_to_session(telegram_chat_id, user_message):

        // Map Telegram chat → Pi session

        session_id = session_map.get(telegram_chat_id)

        IF session_id is None:

            session_id = create_new_session()

            session_map.set(telegram_chat_id, session_id)

        

        // Inject message into Pi session

        session = load_session(session_id)

        session.append(MessageEntry { role: "user", content: user_message })

        

        // Run reactive pipeline (Stages 0-12)

        response = run_reactive_loop(session, user_message)

        

        // Send response back via Telegram

        channel_provider.send_message(telegram_chat_id, response)

        

        // Persist session

        session.append(MessageEntry { role: "assistant", content: response })

        session.flush()

{
  "CodeContent": "/**\n * Session Management & Branching (§5.1-§5.4)\n *\n * Tree-structured conversation session tracking with branching and export.\n */\n\nexport interface SessionMetadata {\n  session_id: string;\n  title: string;\n  parent_session_id?: string;\n  fork_point_entry_id?: string;\n  created_at: string;\n}\n\nexport interface SessionEntry {\n  id: string;\n  entry_type: \"message\" | \"tool_call\" | \"tool_result\" | \"compaction_summary\" | \"branch_summary\";\n  payload: Record<string, unknown>;\n  created_at: string;\n}\n\nexport class Session {\n  public metadata: SessionMetadata;\n  public entries: SessionEntry[] = [];\n\n  constructor(metadata: SessionMetadata) {\n    this.metadata = metadata;\n  }\n\n  public append(entryType: SessionEntry[\"entry_type\"], payload: Record<string, unknown>): SessionEntry {\n    const entry: SessionEntry = {\n      id: \"ent_\" + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8),\n      entry_type: entryType,\n      payload,\n      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n    this.entries.push(entry);\n    return entry;\n  }\n\n  public replayMessages(): Array<Record<string, unknown>> {\n    return this.entries\n      .filter(e => e.entry_type === \"message\")\n      .map(e => e.payload);\n  }\n}\n\nexport class SessionManager {\n  private sessions: Map<string, Session> = new Map();\n\n  public createSession(title: string = \"New Session\"): Session {\n    const sid = \"sess_\" + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8);\n    const meta: SessionMetadata = {\n      session_id: sid,\n      title,\n      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n    const sess = new Session(meta);\n    this.sessions.set(sid, sess);\n    return sess;\n  }\n\n  public forkSession(parentSessionId: string, forkPointId?: string): Session {\n    const parent = this.sessions.get(parentSessionId);\n    if (!parent) {\n      throw new Error(`Parent session ${parentSessionId} not found`);\n    }\n    const childId = \"sess_\" + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8);\n    const meta: SessionMetadata = {\n      session_id: childId,\n      title: `Branch of ${parent.metadata.title}`,\n      parent_session_id: parentSessionId,\n      fork_point_entry_id: forkPointId,\n      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n    const child = new Session(meta);\n    for (const e of parent.entries) {\n      child.entries.push(e);\n      if (forkPointId && e.id === forkPointId) break;\n    }\n    this.sessions.set(childId, child);\n    return child;\n  }\n}\n",

  "CodeContent": "import pytest\nfrom sidecar.session_manager import (\n    SessionEntryType,\n    SessionEntry,\n    SessionMetadata,\n    Session,\n    SessionManager,\n)\nfrom sidecar.session_export import SessionExporter\n\n\ndef test_session_create_and_append():\n    mgr = SessionManager()\n    session = mgr.create_session(title=\"Unit Test Session\")\n    assert session.metadata.title == \"Unit Test Session\"\n\n    session.append_message(\"user\", \"Hello world\")\n    session.append_message(\"assistant\", \"Hi there!\")\n\n    msgs = session.replay_messages()\n    assert len(msgs) == 2\n    assert msgs[0][\"content\"] == \"Hello world\"\n    assert msgs[1][\"content\"] == \"Hi there!\"\n\n\ndef test_session_forking_branch():\n    mgr = SessionManager()\n    parent = mgr.create_session(title=\"Parent Session\")\n    e1 = parent.append_message(\"user\", \"Turn 1\")\n    e2 = parent.append_message(\"assistant\", \"Response 1\")\n    parent.append_message(\"user\", \"Turn 2\")\n\n    # Fork at e2\n    child = mgr.fork_session(parent.metadata.session_id, fork_point_entry_id=e2.id)\n    assert child.metadata.parent_session_id == parent.metadata.session_id\n    assert child.metadata.fork_point_entry_id == e2.id\n\n    # Should have e1, e2, plus the branch summary entry\n    assert len(child.entries) == 3\n    assert child.entries[-1].entry_type == SessionEntryType.BRANCH_SUMMARY.value\n\n\ndef test_session_export_markdown_and_jsonl():\n    mgr = SessionManager()\n    sess = mgr.create_session(title=\"Export Test\")\n    sess.append_message(\"user\", \"What is Locus?\")\n    sess.append(SessionEntryType.TOOL_CALL.value, {\"tool\": \"locus_checkin\", \"arguments\": {\"dcs\": 90}})\n\n    md = SessionExporter.to_markdown(sess)\n    assert \"# Session: Export Test\" in md\n    assert \"### User\" in md\n    assert \"Tool Call\" in md\n\n    jsonl = SessionExporter.to_jsonl(sess)\n    lines = jsonl.strip().split(\"\\n\")\n    assert len(lines) == 3  # metadata + 2 entries\n",
