### Logic extracted



```

APPROVAL GATE:

    FUNCTION queue_approval(task_id, changes, ttl=600):

        approval_store.set(task_id, { changes, status: "pending", expires: now()+ttl })

        notify_user(task_id, changes)  // via Telegram inline keyboard

        

    FUNCTION wait_for_approval(task_id, ttl):

        WHILE now() < expires:

            status = approval_store.get(task_id).status

            IF status == "approved": RETURN true

            IF status == "rejected": RETURN false

            sleep(5)

        RETURN false  // TTL expired = auto-reject

```



### Locus adaptation

- **Component**: `locus/security/approval-gate.ts` + `locus/core/approval_store.py` (sidecar)

- **Repo vs `.locus`**: code in `locus-os`; approval state is runtime-only (in-memory + Redis fallback), not persisted to `.locus`

- **Swappable / off state**: `locus.security.approval_gate.enabled`. Off → all tool calls proceed without user confirmation (only autonomy tier governs).

{
  "CodeContent": "\"\"\"Shell Blocklist & File Safety Engine (§13.7).\n\nEnforces path-level and command-level safety boundaries:\n- Denies read/write access to sensitive system directories (.ssh, .aws, .gnupg, .kube, credentials).\n- Intercepts destructive, unbounded, or forkbomb shell commands before execution.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport re\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple\n\n\nSENSITIVE_HOME_DIRS: Set[str] = {\n    \".ssh\",\n    \".aws\",\n    \".gnupg\",\n    \".kube\",\n    \".docker\",\n    \".azure\",\n    \".config/gh\",\n}\n\nSENSITIVE_HOME_FILES: Set[str] = {\n    \".bashrc\",\n    \".zshrc\",\n    \".profile\",\n    \".bash_profile\",\n    \".zprofile\",\n    \".netrc\",\n    \".pgpass\",\n    \".npmrc\",\n    \".pypirc\",\n    \"id_rsa\",\n    \"id_ed25519\",\n    \"authorized_keys\",\n}\n\nBLOCKED_COMMAND_PATTERNS: List[re.Pattern] = [\n    re.compile(r\"\\brm\\s+-[rRfF]*\\s+(/|~|\\$HOME|\\*\\.|\\.)\\b\"),\n    re.compile(r\":\\(\\)\\s*\\{\\s*:\\s*\\|\\s*:\\s*&\\s*\\}\\s*;\\s*:\"),  # fork bomb\n    re.compile(r\"\\bmkfs\\b\"),\n    re.compile(r\"\\bdd\\s+if=\"),\n    re.compile(r\">\\s*/dev/(sd[a-z]|nvme|hd[a-z])\"),\n    re.compile(r\"\\bshutdown\\b|\\breboot\\b|\\binit\\s+0\\b\"),\n]\n\n\nclass ShellBlocklist:\n    \"\"\"Enforces file path protections and shell command execution blocklists.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        home_dir: Optional[str] = None,\n        custom_blocked_patterns: Optional[List[str]] = None,\n    ) -> None:\n        self.home_dir = os.path.abspath(home_dir or os.path.expanduser(\"~\")).replace(\"\\\\\", \"/\")\n        self.patterns = list(BLOCKED_COMMAND_PATTERNS)\n        if custom_blocked_patterns:\n            for p in custom_blocked_patterns:\n                self.patterns.append(re.compile(p))\n\n    def _normalize_path(self, path: str) -> str:\n        abs_p = os.path.abspath(path).replace(\"\\\\\", \"/\")\n        return abs_p\n\n    def is_read_blocked(self, path: str) -> bool:\n        norm = self._normalize_path(path)\n        base = os.path.basename(norm).lower()\n\n        # Check sensitive file names\n        if base in SENSITIVE_HOME_FILES:\n            return True\n\n        # Check sensitive directory containment\n        for sdir in SENSITIVE_HOME_DIRS:\n            target_dir = f\"{self.home_dir}/{sdir}\"\n            if norm == target_dir or norm.startswith(f\"{target_dir}/\"):\n                return True\n            if f\"/{sdir}/\" in norm or norm.endswith(f\"/{sdir}\"):\n                return True\n\n        return False\n\n    def is_write_denied(self, path: str) -> bool:\n        # Any read-blocked path is strictly write-denied\n        if self.is_read_blocked(path):\n            return True\n\n        norm = self._normalize_path(path)\n        # Block writing directly into system roots\n        if norm in [\"/\", \"C:\", \"C:/\", \"/etc\", \"/usr\", \"/bin\", \"/System\"]:\n            return True\n\n        return False\n\n    def is_command_blocked(self, command: str) -> bool:\n        cmd_clean = command.strip()\n        for pat in self.patterns:\n            if pat.search(cmd_clean):\n                return True\n        return False\n\n    def evaluate_command(self, command: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        blocked = self.is_command_blocked(command)\n        return {\n            \"command\": command,\n            \"allowed\": not blocked,\n            \"reason\": \"Destructive shell command pattern detected\" if blocked else \"ok\",\n        }\n",

  "CodeContent": "/**\n * Shell Blocklist & Policy (§13.7)\n *\n * Intercepts dangerous terminal commands and path access in beforeToolCall hook.\n */\n\nexport const SENSITIVE_DIRS = [\".ssh\", \".aws\", \".gnupg\", \".kube\", \".docker\"];\nexport const SENSITIVE_FILES = [\".bashrc\", \".zshrc\", \".profile\", \"id_rsa\", \"authorized_keys\"];\n\nexport const BLOCKED_COMMANDS = [\n  /\\brm\\s+-[rRfF]*\\s+(/|~|\\$HOME)\\b/,\n  /:\\(\\)\\s*\\{\\s*:\\s*\\|\\s*:\\s*&\\s*\\}\\s*;\\s*:/,\n  /\\bmkfs\\b/,\n  /\\bdd\\s+if=/,\n  />\\s*\\/dev\\/sd/,\n];\n\nexport class ShellPolicy {\n  public isPathBlocked(filePath: string): boolean {\n    const norm = filePath.replace(/\\\\/g, \"/\");\n    const base = norm.split(\"/\").pop() || \"\";\n    if (SENSITIVE_FILES.includes(base)) return true;\n    for (const d of SENSITIVE_DIRS) {\n      if (norm.includes(`/${d}/`) || norm.endsWith(`/${d}`)) return true;\n    }\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  public isCommandBlocked(command: string): boolean {\n    for (const pat of BLOCKED_COMMANDS) {\n      if (pat.test(command)) return true;\n    }\n    return false;\n  }\n}\n",

{
  "CodeContent": "/**\n * Data Redaction Engine (§13.8)\n *\n * Masks API keys, bearer tokens, passwords, and private keys in logs and telemetry.\n */\n\nexport function maskToken(token: string): string {\n  if (token.length < 18) {\n    return \"***REDACTED***\";\n  }\n  return `${token.slice(0, 6)}...${token.slice(-4)}`;\n}\n\nexport function redactText(text: string): string {\n  const patterns: RegExp[] = [\n    /sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}/g,\n    /sk-ant-[A-Za-z0-9-]{20,}/g,\n    /AIza[A-Za-z0-9_-]{35}/g,\n    /ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}/g,\n    /Bearer\\s+[A-Za-z0-9._-]{20,}/g,\n  ];\n\n  let res = text;\n  for (const pat of patterns) {\n    res = res.replace(pat, m => maskToken(m));\n  }\n  return res;\n}\n",
  "Description": "Implement TypeScript DataRedaction in locus-extension/src/security/redact.ts",
  "Overwrite": true,

workflows.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom enum import Enum\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Set\n\n\nclass AutonomyTier(str, Enum):\n    READONLY = \"readonly\"\n    SUPERVISED = \"supervised\"\n    FULL = \"full\"\n\n\nREAD_ONLY_TOOLS: Set[str] = {\n    \"read\",\n    \"grep\",\n    \"find\",\n    \"ls\",\n    \"locus_memory\",\n    \"locus_doctor\",\n    \"locus_pageindex\",\n    \"locus_diagram\",\n    \"locus_research\",\n}\n\nMUTATING_TOOLS: Set[str] = {\n    \"write\",\n    \"edit\",\n    \"bash\",\n    \"terminal\",\n    \"locus_vault\",\n    \"locus_delegate_code\",\n}\n\n\nclass AutonomyManager:\n    \"\"\"Enforces tool execution permissions across configured autonomy tiers.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, current_tier: AutonomyTier = AutonomyTier.SUPERVISED) -> None:\n        self.current_tier = current_tier\n\n    def set_tier(self, tier: AutonomyTier) -> None:\n        self.current_tier = tier\n\n    def can_execute_tool(self, tool_name: str) -> Tuple[bool, bool, str]:\n        \"\"\"Returns (is_allowed, requires_approval, reason).\"\"\"\n        clean_name = tool_name.lower().strip()\n\n        if self.current_tier == typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional\n\n\nDEFAULT_APPROVAL_TTL_SECONDS: float = 600.0  # 10 minutes\n\n\nclass ApprovalStatus(str, Enum):\n    PENDING = \"pending\"\n    APPROVED = \"approved\"\n    REJECTED = \"rejected\"\n    EXPIRED = \"expired\"\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass ApprovalRequest:\n    task_id: str\n    tool_name: str\n    params: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    status: str = ApprovalStatus.PENDING.value\n    created_at: float = field(default_factory=time.time)\n    expires_at: float = 0.0\n\n    def __post_init__(self) -> None:\n        if self.expires_at == 0.0:\n Dict[str, Any]:\n        return asdict(self)\n\n\nclass ApprovalGate:\n    \"\"\"In-memory and event-driven store for pending tool approval requests.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, default_ttl: float = DEFAULT_APPROVAL_TTL_SECONDS) -> None:\n        self.default_ttl = default_ttl\n        self.requests: Dict[str, ApprovalRequest] = {}\n\n    def queue_approval(\n        self,\n        tool_name: str,\n        params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,\n        task_id: Optional[str] = None,\n        ttl: Optional[float] = None,\n    ) -> ApprovalRequest:\n        tid = task_id or (\"appr_\" + str(uuid.uuid4())[:8])\n        now = time.time()\n        timeout = ttl or self.default_ttl\n        req = ApprovalRequest(\n            task_id=tid,\n            tool_name=tool_name,\n            params=params or {},\n            created_at=now,\n            expires_at=now + timeout,\n        )\n        self.requests[tid] = req\n        return req\n\n    def get_status(self, task_id: str) -> {
  "CodeContent": "/**\n * Approval Gate Engine (§13.5)\n *\n * 10-minute TTL approval store for mutating tool calls in SUPERVISED autonomy mode.\n */\n\nexport interface ApprovalRequest {\n  task_id: string;\n  tool_name: string;\n  params: Record<string, unknown>;\n  status: \"pending\" | \"approved\" | \"rejected\" | \"expired\";\n  created_at: number;\n  expires_at: number;\n}\n\nexport class ApprovalGate {\n  private requests: Map<string, ApprovalRequest> = new Map();\n  private defaultTtlSeconds: number = 600;\n\n  public queueApproval(toolName: string, params: Record<string, unknown> = {}): ApprovalRequest {\n    const tid = \"appr_\" + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8);\n    const now = Date.now();\n    const req: ApprovalRequest = {\n      task_id: tid,\n      tool_name: toolName,\n      params,\n      status: \"pending\",\n      created_at: now,\n      expires_at: now + this.defaultTtlSeconds * 1000,\n    };\n    this.requests.set(tid, req);\n    return req;\n  }\n\n  public approve(taskId: string): boolean {\n    const req = this.requests.get(taskId);\n    if (!req) return false;\n    if (Date.now() > req.expires_at) {\n      req.status = \"expired\";\n      return false;\n    }\n    if (req.status === \"pending\") {\n      req.status = \"approved\";\n      return true;\n    }\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  public reject(taskId: string): boolean {\n    const req = this.requests.get(taskId);\n    if (!req) return false;\n    if (req.status === \"pending\") {\n      req.status = \"rejected\";\n      return true;\n    }\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  public getStatus(taskId: string): string {\n    const req = this.requests.get(taskId);\n    if (!req) return \"not_found\";\n    if (req.status === \"pending\" && Date.now() > req.expires_at) {\n      req.status = \"expired\";\n    }\n    return req.status;\n  }\n}\n",

4642: ### Stripped Mathematical & Algorithmic Logic
4643: 
4644: ```
4645: STEP 1: Operating Mode Capacity Filter
4646:     - Inputs: Current DCS (0.0 - 10.0), Operating Mode, Candidate Task Pool
4647:     - Task Difficulty Thresholds:
4648:       * SURVIVAL  (DCS 0.0 - 2.0)  → Filter: Task.difficulty <= 2, Non-negotiable health only
4649:       * RECOVERY  (DCS 2.1 - 4.0)  → Filter: Task.difficulty <= 4, Light administrative only
4650:       * NORMAL    (DCS 4.1 - 6.0)  → Filter: Task.difficulty <= 7, Balanced standard tasks
4651:       * DEEP_WORK (DCS 6.1 - 8.0)  → Filter: Task.difficulty <= 9, Complex analytical tasks
4652:       * PEAK      (DCS 8.1 - 10.0) → Filter: All tasks eligible, Highest difficulty first
4653:     - Formula: EligibleTasks = { t ∈ Pool | t.min_dcs <= DCS ∧ t.difficulty <= ModeMaxDiff }
4654: 
4655: STEP 2: Task Weight Score (TWS) Ranking
4656:     - Formula: TWS = (D * 0.35) + (L * 0.25) + (U * 0.20) + (C * 0.20) + LagBonus
4657:       where:
4658:         D = Difficulty (1 - 10)
4659:         L = Leverage (1 - 10, long-term multiplier impact)
4660:         U = Urgency (1 - 10, proximity to hard external deadline)
4661:         C = Consequence of Inaction (1 - 10, penalty if neglected)
4662:         LagBonus = min(2.5, deferral_count * 0.5)
4663:     - Output: Tasks sorted in strict descending order of TWS.
4664: 
4665: STEP 3: Operating Mode Time-Block Grid Allocation
4666:     - Daily Block Budgets by Mode:
4667:       * PEAK:      4 Deep Blocks (90m) + 2 Light Blocks (30m) = 7.0h cognitive load
4668:       * DEEP_WORK: 3 Deep Blocks (90m) + 3 Light Blocks (30m) = 6.0h cognitive load
4669:       * NORMAL:    2 Deep Blocks (90m) + 4 Light Blocks (30m) = 5.0h cognitive load
4670:       * RECOVERY:  1 Deep Block  (60m) + 3 Light Blocks (20m) = 2.0h cognitive load
4671:       * SURVIVAL:  0 Deep Blocks       + 2 Light Blocks (15m) = 0.5h basic maintenance
4672: 
4673: STEP 4: Faction Balance Constrained Assignment
4674:     - Faction Targets:
4675:       * Craft (Work / Engineering):     Target 40% (Tolerance ±5%)
4676:       * Health (Physical / Mental):     Target 25% (Tolerance ±5%)
4677:       * Leverage (Systems / Wealth):    Target 20% (Tolerance ±5%)
4678:       * Expression (Writing / Art):     Target 15% (Tolerance ±5%)
4679:     - Assignment Rule:
4680:       Greedily assign highest TWS task to next open Deep block UNLESS assigning that task
4681:       causes that faction's weekly allocated hours to exceed Target + Tolerance while an
4682:       under-represented faction has eligible tasks waiting.
4683: 
4684: STEP 5: Ultradian Recovery Buffer Insertion
4685:     - Rules:
4686:       * After every 90-minute Deep Block: Insert mandatory 20-minute Recovery Buffer (No screens, hydration, movement).
4687:       * After every 30-minute Light Block: Insert 5-minute transition buffer.
4688:       * Maximum continuous cognitive duration: 90 minutes without exception.

4695:           ASSERT Outcome(Project.outcome_id).faction ∈ {Craft, Health, Leverage, Expression}

6271: 
6272: ### Architectural Foundation: Why CouchDB + LiveSync Beats Git & Syncthing
6273: 
6274: Locus replaces legacy Git sync and Syncthing with self-hosted **CouchDB + Obsidian LiveSync** for three non-negotiable architectural reasons:
6275: 1. **iOS Background Execution Immunity**:
6276:    - iOS terminates background processes after ~30 seconds. Git fetch/merge operations and Syncthing relay daemons fail silently or corrupt state on mobile devices.
6277:    - Obsidian LiveSync uses standard HTTP/1.1 REST calls against CouchDB's replication protocol. Replication seamlessly pauses on iOS background suspend and immediately resumes upon app reactivation or scheduled iOS background fetch without data loss.
6278: 2. **Elimination of Git Merge Conflict Bloat**:
6279:    - Git on mobile frequently produces merge conflict markers (`<<<<<<< HEAD ... ======= ... >>>>>>>`) directly inside markdown notes, breaking YAML frontmatter parsing, corrupting PageIndex tree builders, and causing runtime LLM hallucinations.
6280:    - CouchDB uses Multi-Version Concurrency Control (MVCC) with deterministic revision trees (`_rev`). Conflicted branches are tracked at the document level (`_conflicts`), deterministically reconciled via 3-way text diff or revision winning rules, and never corrupt raw note text on disk.

1: """sidecar/life_os/dcs.py - Daily Capacity Score (DCS) calculation.
2: 
3: Implements Spec §25.2:
4: DCS = ((E + M + S) / 3) * (1 - ST / 20)
5: Where E=Energy, M=Mood, S=Sleep, ST=Stress (each 1-10 scale).
6: Clamped to [0.0, 10.0].
7: """
8: 
9: from __future__ import annotations
10: 
11: 
12: def calculate_dcs(
13:     energy: float,
14:     mood: float,
15:     sleep: float,
16:     stress: float,
17:     stale_checkin: bool = False,
18: ) -> float:
19:     """Calculate Daily Capacity Score (0.0 to 10.0 float).
20: 
21:     Parameters:
22:     - energy: 1-10
23:     - mood: 1-10
24:     - sleep: 1-10
25:     - stress: 1-10
26:     - stale_checkin: apply 0.9 staleness penalty if no check-in today
27:     """
28:     e = max(1.0, min(10.0, float(energy)))
29:     m = max(1.0, min(10.0, float(mood)))
30:     s = max(1.0, min(10.0, float(sleep)))
31:     st = max(1.0, min(10.0, float(stress)))
32: 
33:     base = (e + m + s) / 3.0
34:     factor = 1.0 - (st / 20.0)
35:     score = base * factor
36: 
37:     if stale_checkin:
38:         score *= 0.9
39: 
40:     return max(0.0, min(10.0, round(score, 2)))

Focusing on feature implementation, F-0056 requires components for goal management, action discrepancy analysis, deferral handling, and performance lag assessment. F-0057 needs a scheduling algorithm and a faction balancing mechanism. F-0111's requirements need to be identified.


Identifying new features including emergency task injection, an exhaustion predictor, faction rebalancing, a review cadence, goal stack enforcement, cross-faction efficiency, a four-level emergency protocol, and a tag hierarchy with semantic indexing. Confirmed the need for TypeScript equivalents in the extension to maintain model consistency.

Defined the initial structure for goal stack management with outcomes, projects, and tasks organized in a hierarchical manner. A class for `GoalStackManager` will handle the relations and management.


Developed the action gap calculation to identify factions needing attention, using declared priority and actual versus target hours. Implemented deferral tracking with escalating severity levels based on deferral count, triggering warnings, escalation, or automatic parking.

Defined lag scoring based on the difference between target and actual hours, adjusting task time estimates (TWS) to prioritize lagging factions or reward those ahead. Emergency tasks will bypass regular ordering and be handled immediately.


Implemented an emergency task injector to handle urgent tasks, respecting a predefined crisis hierarchy to ensure essential tasks are prioritized. Developed an exhaustion predictor to monitor stress and workload, recommending recovery modes based on predicted drops in the DCS.

Established a weekly faction rebalancing mechanism to ensure target time allocations are met, calculating deficits and adjusting weights for the following week. Designed a mode capacity filter that adapts task difficulty and faction focus based on the DCS, effectively managing resources in different states of cognitive load.


A six-step scheduling algorithm is being defined to include difficulty eligibility, a Time Weighted Score (TWS) ranking that incorporates lag bonus, block grid allocation based on cognitive states, faction balance constraints, and ultradian recovery buffers, along with goal stack validation.

The `SchedulerProvider` and `SixStepScheduler` classes will manage the scheduling process. Review cadence will incorporate Daily Standups, Weekly Retrospectives, and Monthly Deep Reviews managed by classes `ReviewCadenceManager`, `ReviewSession`, and `ReviewType`.

Goal enforcement will ensure a parent-child relationship between Tasks, Projects, and Outcomes, surfacing orphan tasks. Cross-faction task hours will be split according to primary/secondary weightings to avoid double-counting.

{
  "CodeContent": "\"\"\"sidecar/life_os/deferral.py - Deferral Detection (3/5/8+).\n\nImplements Spec §25.7:\nDEFERRAL THRESHOLDS:\n- 3x defer -> warn: \"Consider dropping or delegating\"\n- 5x defer -> escalate: surfaced at weekly review\n- 8x defer -> flag as phantom task: auto-parked with review note\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom enum import Enum\nfrom typing import Dict, List, Optional\n\n\nclass DeferralAction(str, Enum):\n    NONE = \"none\"\n    WARN = \"warn\"\n    ESCALATE = \"escalate\"\n    PARK_PHANTOM = \"park_phantom\"\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass DeferralResult:\n    task_id: str\n    task_title: str\n    deferral_count: int\n    action: DeferralAction\n    message: str\n    is_parked: bool = False\n\n\ndef evaluate_deferral_thresholds(deferral_count: int) -> tuple[DeferralAction, str]:\n    \"\"\"Evaluate task deferral count against 3/5/8+ thresholds.\"\"\"\n    if deferral_count >= 8:\n        return (\n            DeferralAction.PARK_PHANTOM,\n            f\"Deferred {deferral_count} times: flagged as phantom task. Automatically parked with review note.\",\n        )\n    elif deferral_count >= 5:\n        return (\n            DeferralAction.ESCALATE,\n            f\"Deferred {deferral_count} times: escalated for mandatory weekly review triage.\",\n        )\n    elif deferral_count >= 3:\n        return (\n            DeferralAction.WARN,\n            f\"Deferred {deferral_count} times: consider dropping, scoping down, or delegating.\",\n        )\n    return DeferralAction.NONE, f\"Deferred {deferral_count} times: normal status.\"\n\n\nclass DeferralTracker:\n    \"\"\"Tracks task deferrals, applies thresholds, and auto-parks phantom tasks.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        self.deferral_counts: dict[str, int] = {}\n        self.parked_tasks: set[str] = set()\n\n    def record_deferral(self, task_id: str, task_title: str) -> DeferralResult:\n        \"\"\"Increment deferral count for a task and evaluate action.\"\"\"\n        count = self.deferral_counts.get(task_id, 0) + 1\n        self.deferral_counts[task_id] = count\n        action, msg = evaluate_deferral_thresholds(count)\n        is_parked = False\n        if action == DeferralAction.PARK_PHANTOM:\n            self.parked_tasks.add(task_id)\n            is_parked = True\n\n        return DeferralResult(\n            task_id=task_id,\n            task_title=task_title,\n            deferral_count=count,\n            action=action,\n            message=msg,\n            is_parked=is_parked,\n        )\n\n    def is_task_parked(self, task_id: str) -> bool:\n        return task_id in self.parked_tasks\n\n    def get_weekly_review_escalations(self) -> list[str]:\n        \"\"\"Return list of task IDs deferred 5 or more times.\"\"\"\n        return [tid for tid, cnt in self.deferral_counts.items() if cnt >= 5]\n",

{
  "CodeContent": "\"\"\"sidecar/life_os/lag.py - Faction Lag Score and TWS Lag Bonus.\n\nImplements Spec §25.8:\nLAG SCORE = cumulative hours a faction is behind its weekly target.\nLag Bonus Rules:\n- Lag > 3h -> TWS + 2 for all that faction's tasks\n- Lag > 6h -> TWS + 4 (faction in crisis)\n- Ahead of target (lag < 0) -> TWS − 1\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom typing import Dict\n\nfrom sidecar.life_os.factions import Faction\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass FactionLagStatus:\n    faction: Faction\n    target_hours: float\n    actual_hours: float\n    lag_hours: float\n    tws_lag_bonus: float\n    is_in_crisis: bool\n\n\ndef calculate_lag_score(target_hours: float, actual_hours: float) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Calculate cumulative hours a faction is behind target.\"\"\"\n    return round(target_hours - actual_hours, 2)\n\n\ndef get_lag_tws_bonus(lag_hours: float) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Compute TWS bonus adjustment based on faction lag hours.\n\n    Spec §25.8:\n    - Lag > 6.0h -> +4.0 (crisis)\n    - Lag > 3.0h -> +2.0\n    - Lag < 0.0h -> -1.0 (ahead of schedule)\n    - Otherwise -> 0.0\n    \"\"\"\n    if lag_hours > 6.0:\n        return 4.0\n    elif lag_hours > 3.0:\n        return 2.0\n    elif lag_hours < 0.0:\n        return -1.0\n    return 0.0\n\n\ndef compute_all_faction_lags(\n    weekly_targets: dict[Faction, float],\n    weekly_actuals: dict[Faction, float],\n) -> dict[Faction, FactionLagStatus]:\n    \"\"\"Compute lag statuses and TWS adjustments across all factions.\"\"\"\n    results = {}\n    for faction in Faction:\n        target = weekly_targets.get(faction, 0.0)\n        actual = weekly_actuals.get(faction, 0.0)\n        lag = calculate_lag_score(target, actual)\n        bonus = get_lag_tws_bonus(lag)\n        results[faction] = FactionLagStatus(\n            faction=faction,\n            target_hours=target,\n            actual_hours=actual,\n            lag_hours=lag,\n            tws_lag_bonus=bonus,\n            is_in_crisis=lag > 6.0,\n        )\n    return results\n",

{
  "CodeContent": "\"\"\"sidecar/life_os/emergency.py - Emergency Task Injection.\n\nImplements Spec §25.9:\nEMERGENCY INJECTION:\n- Tasks tagged EMERGENCY bypass standard TWS ordering.\n- Inserted at the top of the schedule.\n- Respects only faction crisis hierarchy: Health > Leverage > Craft > Expression.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom typing import List, Optional\n\nfrom sidecar.life_os.factions import Faction\nfrom sidecar.life_os.goal_stack import GoalTask\n\n\n# Crisis hierarchy priority weights\nCRISIS_HIERARCHY: dict[Faction, int] = {\n    Faction.HEALTH: 4,\n    Faction.LEVERAGE: 3,\n    Faction.CRAFT: 2,\n    Faction.EXPRESSION: 1,\n}\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass ScheduledTaskEntry:\n    task: GoalTask\n    faction: Faction\n    tws: float\n    is_emergency: bool = False\n\n\nclass EmergencyInjector:\n    \"\"\"Manages emergency task injection and priority queue ordering.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, enabled: bool = True) -> None:\n        self.enabled = enabled\n\n    def order_schedule(\n        self,\n        normal_entries: list[ScheduledTaskEntry],\n        emergency_entries: list[ScheduledTaskEntry],\n    ) -> list[ScheduledTaskEntry]:\n        \"\"\"Order tasks into dispatch schedule.\n\n        If enabled, emergency tasks are sorted by crisis hierarchy\n        (Health > Leverage > Craft > Expression) then TWS, and placed at top.\n        Normal tasks follow, sorted strictly by descending TWS.\n        \"\"\"\n        if not self.enabled:\n            # If disabled, treat all tasks identically by TWS\n            combined = normal_entries + emergency_entries\n            return sorted(combined, key=lambda x: x.tws, reverse=True)\n\n        sorted_emergencies = sorted(\n            emergency_entries,\n            key=lambda x: (CRISIS_HIERARCHY.get(x.faction, 0), x.tws),\n            reverse=True,\n        )\n\n        sorted_normals = sorted(\n            normal_entries,\n            key=lambda x: x.tws,\n            reverse=True,\n        )\n\n        return sorted_emergencies + sorted_normals\n",

consecutive_high_d_hours: hours of difficulty >= 8.0 completed recently\n        - sleep_deficit_hours: sleep shortfall below target (e.g. 8.0 - actual)\n        - stress_trend_score: 1.0 to 10.0 scale reflecting recent stress spike\n        \"\"\"\n        if not self.enabled:\n            return ExhaustionPrediction(\n                predicted_dcs_drop=0.0,\n                current_dcs=current_dcs,\n                predicted_dcs=current_dcs,\n                is_at_risk=False,\n                recommended_mode=None,\n                reasoning=\"Exhaustion predictor is disabled.\",\n            )\n\n        # Drop modeling\n        # Every 2h of high-D adds ~0.6 drop\n        d_penalty = (consecutive_high_d_hours / 2.0) * 0.6\n        # Sleep deficit: >2h deficit adds ~0.8 drop per hour\n        sleep_penalty = max(0.0, sleep_deficit_hours) * 0.8\n        # High stress (>6.0) adds linear penalty\n        stress_penalty = max(0.0, (stress_trend_score - 6.0)) * 0.5\n\n        total_drop = round(d_penalty + sleep_penalty + stress_penalty, 2)\n        predicted_dcs = max(0.0, round(current_dcs - total_drop, 2))\n        is_at_risk = total_drop > 2.0\n\n        recommended_mode = None\n        reasoning = f\"Predicted DCS drop: {total_drop:.2f} (High-D: {d_penalty:.2f}, Sleep: {sleep_penalty:.2f}, Stress: {stress_penalty:.2f}).\"\n\n        if is_at_risk:\n            if predicted_dcs <= 2.0:\n                recommended_mode = OperatingMode.SURVIVAL\n            elif predicted_dcs <= 4.0:\n                recommended_mode = OperatingMode.RECOVERY\n            else:\n                recommended_mode = OperatingMode.NORMAL\n            reasoning += f\" Severe fatigue risk detected! {
  "CodeContent": "\"\"\"sidecar/life_os/rebalance.py - Weekly Faction Rebalance.\n\nImplements Spec §25.11:\nWEEKLY REBALANCE (Sunday 02:00 IST):\n- actual = PG query: SUM(duration) per faction for current week\n- FOR EACH faction:\n    deficit = target_pct − actual_pct\n    next_week_weight = base_weight + (deficit × correction_factor)\n- Normalized so weights sum to 1.0\n- Writes adjusted weights to faction_weights table for next week's scheduling.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom typing import Dict\n\nfrom sidecar.life_os.factions import Faction, FACTION_TARGET_PERCENTAGES\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass FactionRebalanceRecord:\n    faction: Faction\n    target_pct: float\n    actual_pct: float\n    deficit_pct: float\n    previous_weight: float\n    new_weight: float\n\n\ndef compute_weekly_rebalance(\n    actual_hours: dict[Faction, float],\n    base_weights: dict[Faction, float] | None = None,\n    target_percentages: dict[Faction, float] | None = None,\n    correction_factor: float = 0.5,\n) -> dict[Faction, FactionRebalanceRecord]:\n    \"\"\"Compute rebalanced faction weights for upcoming week.\"\"\"\n    targets = target_percentages or FACTION_TARGET_PERCENTAGES\n    bases = base_weights or FACTION_TARGET_PERCENTAGES\n\n    total_actual = sum(actual_hours.values())\n    raw_new_weights: dict[Faction, float] = {}\n    records: dict[Faction, FactionRebalanceRecord] = {}\n\n    for faction in Faction:\n        act_hrs = actual_hours.get(faction, 0.0)\n        act_pct = (act_hrs / total_actual) if total_actual > 0 else 0.0\n        tgt_pct = targets.get(faction, 0.25)\n        deficit = tgt_pct - act_pct\n\n        base_wt = bases.get(faction, tgt_pct)\n        # Apply correction factor to deficit\n        raw_wt = max(0.05, base_wt + (deficit * correction_factor))\n        raw_new_weights[faction] = raw_wt\n\n    # Normalize weights so sum is 1.0\n    total_raw = sum(raw_new_weights.values())\n    for faction in Faction:\n        act_hrs = actual_hours.get(faction, 0.0)\n        act_pct = (act_hrs / total_actual) if total_actual > 0 else 0.0\n        tgt_pct = targets.get(faction, 0.25)\n        deficit = tgt_pct - act_pct\n        base_wt = bases.get(faction, tgt_pct)\n        norm_wt = round(raw_new_weights[faction] / total_raw, 4)\n\n        records[faction] = FactionRebalanceRecord(\n            faction=faction,\n            target_pct=round(tgt_pct, 4),\n            actual_pct=round(act_pct, 4),\n            deficit_pct=round(deficit, 4),\n            previous_weight=round(base_wt, 4),\n            new_weight=norm_wt,\n        )\n\n    return records\n\n\nclass WeeklyFactionRebalancer:\n    \"\"\"Manages Sunday 02:00 IST faction weight rebalancing.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, enabled: bool = True, correction_factor: float = 0.5) -> None:\n        self.enabled = enabled\n        self.correction_factor = correction_factor\n        self.current_weights: dict[Faction, float] = dict(FACTION_TARGET_PERCENTAGES)\n\n    def rebalance(self, actual_hours: dict[Faction, float]) -> dict[Faction, float]:\n        if not self.enabled:\n            return dict(self.current_weights)\n\n        records = compute_weekly_rebalance(\n            actual_hours=actual_hours,\n            base_weights=self.current_weights,\n            correction_factor=self.correction_factor,\n        )\n        self.current_weights = {f: rec.new_weight for f, rec in records.items()}\n        return dict(self.current_weights)\n",

±5%\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass FactionAllocationState:\n    current_hours: float\n    total_hours: float\n\n    @property\n    def current_pct(self) -> float:\n        return (self.current_hours / self.total_hours) if self.total_hours > 0 else 0.0\n\n\nclass FactionBalancer:\n    \"\"\"Mathematical constraint solver for weekly faction balance.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        targets: Optional[dict[Faction, float]] = None,\n        tolerance: float = FACTION_TOLERANCE,\n    ) -> None:\n        self.targets = targets or dict(SCHEDULER_FACTION_TARGETS)\n        self.tolerance = tolerance\n\n    def can_assign_task(\n        self,\n        faction: Faction,\n        task_duration_hours: float,\n        current_allocations: dict[Faction, float],\n        waiting_factions: set[Faction],\n    ) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Check if assigning task violates faction tolerance constraint while other factions lag.\"\"\"\n        total_curr = sum(current_allocations.values())\n        proj_total = total_curr + task_duration_hours\n        if proj_total <= 0:\n            return True\n\n        curr_faction_hrs = current_allocations.get(faction, 0.0)\n        proj_faction_hrs = curr_faction_hrs + task_duration_hours\n        proj_pct = proj_faction_hrs / proj_total\n\n        target_pct = self.targets.get(faction, 0.25)\n        max_allowed_pct = target_pct + self.tolerance\n\n        # If assignment would exceed max allowed tolerance\n        if proj_pct > max_allowed_pct:\n            # Check if any under-represented faction is waiting\n            for other in waiting_factions:\n                if other != faction:\n                    other_hrs = current_allocations.get(other, 0.0)\n                    other_pct = other_hrs / proj_total\n                    other_tgt = self.targets.get(other, 0.25)\n                    # If other faction is below its target - tolerance\n                    if other_pct < (other_tgt - self.tolerance):\n                        return False\n\n        return True\n\n    def get_most_starved_faction(\n        self,\n        current_allocations: dict[Faction, float],\n        eligible_factions: set[Faction],\n    ) -> Optional[Faction]:\n        \"\"\"Find the faction furthest below its target percentage.\"\"\"\n        if not eligible_factions:\n            return None\n        total_curr = sum(current_allocations.values())\n        max_deficit = -1.0\n        most_starved = None\n\n        for faction in eligible_factions:\n            curr_hrs = current_allocations.get(faction, 0.0)\n            curr_pct = (curr_hrs / total_curr) if total_curr > 0 else 0.0\n            tgt_pct = self.targets.get(faction, 0.25)\n            deficit = tgt_pct - curr_pct\n            if deficit > max_deficit:\n                max_deficit = deficit\n                most_starved = faction\n\n        return most_starved\n",

(TWS) Ranking\n- STEP 3: Operating Mode Time-Block Grid Allocation\n- STEP 4: Faction Balance Constrained Assignment\n- STEP 5: Ultradian Recovery Buffer Insertion\n- STEP 6: Three-Layer Goal Stack Validation\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom enum import Enum\nfrom typing import Dict, List, Optional, Set\n\nfrom sidecar.life_os.factions import Faction\nfrom sidecar.life_os.modes import OperatingMode, resolve_operating_mode\nfrom sidecar.life_os.faction_balancer import FactionBalancer, SCHEDULER_FACTION_TARGETS\nfrom sidecar.life_os.goal_stack import GoalStackManager, GoalTask, Project, Outcome\n\n\nclass BlockType(str, Enum):\n    DEEP = \"deep\"\n    LIGHT = \"light\"\n    RECOVERY = \"recovery\"\n    TRANSITION = \"transition\"\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass ScheduleBlock:\n    block_index: int\n    block_type: BlockType\n    duration_minutes: int\n    assigned_task: Optional[GoalTask] = None\n    faction: Optional[Faction] = None\n    tws_score: float = 0.0\n    notes: str = \"\"\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass DailyScheduleManifest:\n    operating_mode: OperatingMode\n    dcs_score: float\n    total_cognitive_hours: float\n    blocks: list[ScheduleBlock]\n    assigned_task_count: int\n    unassigned_task_count: int\n    faction_distribution_pct: dict[str, float]\n    validation_passed: bool\n    validation_errors: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n\n\ndef calculate_scheduler_tws(\n    difficulty: float,\n    leverage: float,\n    urgency: float,\n    consequence: float,\n    deferral_count: int = 0,\n    faction_lag_bonus: float = 0.0,\n) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Calculate TWS according to Spec §25.12 Step 2.\n\n    Formula: (D * 0.35) + (L * 0.25) + (U * 0.20) + (C * 0.20) + LagBonus\n    where LagBonus = min(2.5, deferral_count * 0.5) + faction_lag_bonus\n    \"\"\"\n    d = max(1.0, min(10.0, float(difficulty)))\n    lev = max(1.0, min(10.0, float(leverage)))\n    u = max(1.0, min(10.0, float(urgency)))\n    c = max(1.0, min(10.0, float(consequence)))\n\n    base = (d * 0.35) + (lev * 0.25) + (u * 0.20) + (c * 0.20)\n    deferral_bonus = min(2.5, deferral_count * 0.5)\n    total = base + deferral_bonus + faction_lag_bonus\n    return round(total, 2)\n\n\nclass SixStepScheduler:\n    \"\"\"Deterministic Six-Step Schedule Generator.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        goal_manager: Optional[GoalStackManager] = None,\n        balancer: Optional[FactionBalancer] = None,\n    ) -> None:\n        self.goal_manager = goal_manager or GoalStackManager()\n        self.balancer = balancer or FactionBalancer()\n\n    def generate_schedule(\n        self,\n        dcs: float,\n        task_pool: list[GoalTask],\n        task_factions: dict[str, Faction],\n        current_weekly_hours: Optional[dict[Faction, float]] = None,\n    ) -> DailyScheduleManifest:\n        mode = resolve_operating_mode(dcs)\n        allocations = dict(current_weekly_hours or {f: 0.0 for f in Faction})\n\n        # --- STEP 1: Operating Mode Capacity Filter\n        eligible_tasks: list[GoalTask] = []\n        for task in task_pool:\n            diff = task.difficulty\n            faction = task_factions.get(task.id, Faction.CRAFT)\n\n            if mode == OperatingMode.SURVIVAL:\n                if diff <= 2.0 and faction == Faction.HEALTH:\n                    eligible_tasks.append(task)\n            elif mode == OperatingMode.RECOVERY:\n                if diff <= 4.0:\n                    eligible_tasks.append(task)\n            elif mode == OperatingMode.NORMAL:\n                if diff <= 7.0:\n                    eligible_tasks.append(task)\n            elif mode == OperatingMode.DEEP_WORK:\n                if diff <= 9.0:\n                    eligible_tasks.append(task)\n            else:  # PEAK\n                eligible_tasks.append(task)\n\n        # --- STEP 2: Task Weight Score (TWS) Ranking\n        scored_tasks: list[tuple[GoalTask, float]] = []\n        for task in eligible_tasks:\n            score = calculate_scheduler_tws(\n                difficulty=task.difficulty,\n                leverage=task.leverage,\n                urgency=task.urgency,\n                consequence=task.consequence,\n                deferral_count=task.deferral_count,\n            )\n            scored_tasks.append((task, score))\n\n        # Sort strictly descending by TWS\n        scored_tasks.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)\n\n        # --- STEP 3: Time-Block Grid Allocation by Mode\n        # Grid definition: list of (block_type, duration_minutes)\n        if mode == OperatingMode.PEAK:\n            grid_spec = [\n                (BlockType.DEEP, 90), (BlockType.DEEP, 90),\n                (BlockType.DEEP, 90), (BlockType.DEEP, 90),\n                (BlockType.LIGHT, 30), (BlockType.LIGHT, 30),\n            ]\n        elif mode == OperatingMode.DEEP_WORK:\n            grid_spec = [\n                (BlockType.DEEP, 90), (BlockType.DEEP, 90),\n                (BlockType.DEEP, 90),\n                (BlockType.LIGHT, 30), (BlockType.LIGHT, 30), (BlockType.LIGHT, 30),\n            ]\n        elif mode == OperatingMode.NORMAL:\n            grid_spec = [\n                (BlockType.DEEP, 90), (BlockType.DEEP, 90),\n                (BlockType.LIGHT, 30), (BlockType.LIGHT, 30),\n                (BlockType.LIGHT, 30), (BlockType.LIGHT, 30),\n            ]\n        elif mode == OperatingMode.RECOVERY:\n            grid_spec = [\n                (BlockType.DEEP, 60),\n                (BlockType.LIGHT, 20), (BlockType.LIGHT, 20), (BlockType.LIGHT, 20),\n            ]\n        else:  # SURVIVAL\n            grid_spec = [\n                (BlockType.LIGHT, 15), (BlockType.LIGHT, 15),\n            ]\n\n        # --- STEP 4 & 5: Assignment + Ultradian Buffers\n        final_blocks: list[ScheduleBlock] = []\n        available_tasks = list(scored_tasks)\n        block_idx = 1\n        scheduled_task_ids: set[str] = set()\n\n        for b_type, duration in grid_spec:\n            duration_hrs = duration / 60.0\n            assigned_task = None\n            assigned_faction = None\n            assigned_tws = 0.0\n\n            # Find best fitting task respecting faction constraints\n            waiting_factions = {task_factions.get(t.id, Faction.CRAFT) for t, _ in available_tasks}\n            chosen_index = -1\n\n            for idx, (t, score) in enumerate(available_tasks):\n                f = task_factions.get(t.id, Faction.CRAFT)\n                if self.balancer.can_assign_task(f, duration_hrs, allocations, waiting_factions):\n                    chosen_index = idx\n                    assigned_task = t\n                    assigned_faction = f\n                    assigned_tws = score\n                    break\n\n            if chosen_index >= 0:\n                available_tasks.pop(chosen_index)\n                allocations[assigned_faction] += duration_hrs\n                scheduled_task_ids.add(assigned_task.id)\n\n            # Insert work block\n            final_blocks.append(\n                ScheduleBlock(\n                    block_index=block_idx,\n                    block_type=b_type,\n                    duration_minutes=duration,\n                    assigned_task=assigned_task,\n                    faction=assigned_faction,\n                    tws_score=assigned_tws,\n                )\n            )\n            block_idx += 1\n\n            # STEP 5: Ultradian Buffer Insertion\n            if b_type == BlockType.DEEP and duration >= 60:\n                final_blocks.append(\n                    ScheduleBlock(\n                        block_index=block_idx,\n                        block_type=BlockType.RECOVERY,\n                        duration_minutes=20,\n                        notes=\"Mandatory 20-minute Ultradian Recovery Buffer (No screens, hydration, movement)\",\n                    )\n                )\n                block_idx += 1\n            elif b_type == BlockType.LIGHT:\n                final_blocks.append(\n                    ScheduleBlock(\n                        block_index=block_idx,\n                        block_type=BlockType.TRANSITION,\n                        duration_minutes=5,\n                        notes=\"Transition buffer\",\n                    )\n                )\n                block_idx += 1\n\n        # --- STEP 6: Three-Layer Goal Stack Validation\n        validation_errors: list[str] = []\n        for blk in final_blocks:\n            if blk.assigned_task:\n                valid, err = self.goal_manager.validate_task_ancestry(blk.assigned_task.id)\n                if not valid and err:\n                    validation_errors.append(err)\n\n        total_cog_hours = sum(b.duration_minutes for b in final_blocks if b.block_type in (BlockType.DEEP, BlockType.LIGHT)) / 60.0\n        total_alloc_hrs = sum(allocations.values())\n        dist = {\n            f.value: round((allocations.get(f, 0.0) / total_alloc_hrs) * 100, 1) if total_alloc_hrs > 0 else 0.0\n            for f in Faction\n        }\n\n        return DailyScheduleManifest(\n            operating_mode=mode,\n            dcs_score=dcs,\n            total_cognitive_hours=round(total_cog_hours, 2),\n            blocks=final_blocks,\n            assigned_task_count=len(scheduled_task_ids),\n            unassigned_task_count=len(task_pool) - len(scheduled_task_ids),\n            faction_distribution_pct=dist,\n            validation_passed=len(validation_errors) == 0,\n            validation_errors=validation_errors,\n        )\n\n\nclass SchedulerProvider:\n    \"\"\"Provider interface for Life OS deterministic scheduler.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        self.scheduler = SixStepScheduler()\n\n    def plan_day(\n        self,\n        dcs: float,\n        tasks: list[GoalTask],\n        task_factions: dict[str, Faction],\n    ) -> DailyScheduleManifest:\n        return self.scheduler.generate_schedule(dcs, tasks, task_factions)\n",

{
  "CodeContent": "\"\"\"sidecar/life_os/cross_faction.py - Cross-Faction Efficiency & Multi-Tag Accounting.\n\nImplements Spec §25.15:\n- Tasks tagged with multiple factions count toward both targets (weighted by primary/secondary split).\n- Prevents double-counting by strictly partitioning total logged duration.\n- Default split: Primary 70%, Secondary 30% (customizable per task).\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom typing import Dict, Optional\n\nfrom sidecar.life_os.factions import Faction\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass CrossFactionAllocation:\n    task_id: str\n    total_hours: float\n    primary_faction: Faction\n    secondary_faction: Optional[Faction]\n    primary_hours: float\n    secondary_hours: float\n\n\nclass CrossFactionAllocator:\n    \"\"\"Calculates weighted hour allocations for multi-faction tasks.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, enabled: bool = True, default_primary_ratio: float = 0.7) -> None:\n        self.enabled = enabled\n        self.default_primary_ratio = default_primary_ratio\n\n    def allocate(\n        self,\n        task_id: str,\n        total_hours: float,\n        primary_faction: Faction,\n        secondary_faction: Optional[Faction] = None,\n        primary_ratio: Optional[float] = None,\n    ) -> CrossFactionAllocation:\n        \"\"\"Partition task duration across primary and secondary factions.\"\"\"\n        if not self.enabled or not secondary_faction or primary_faction == secondary_faction:\n            return CrossFactionAllocation(\n                task_id=task_id,\n                total_hours=total_hours,\n                primary_faction=primary_faction,\n                secondary_faction=None,\n                primary_hours=total_hours,\n                secondary_hours=0.0,\n            )\n\n        ratio = primary_ratio if primary_ratio is not None else self.default_primary_ratio\n        ratio = max(0.5, min(0.95, ratio))\n\n        prim_hrs = round(total_hours * ratio, 2)\n        sec_hrs = round(total_hours - prim_hrs, 2)\n\n        return CrossFactionAllocation(\n            task_id=task_id,\n            total_hours=total_hours,\n            primary_faction=primary_faction,\n            secondary_faction=secondary_faction,\n            primary_hours=prim_hrs,\n            secondary_hours=sec_hrs,\n        )\n\n    def accumulate_allocations(\n        self,\n        allocations: list[CrossFactionAllocation],\n    ) -> dict[Faction, float]:\n        \"\"\"Aggregate total hours across factions from multiple cross-faction tasks.\"\"\"\n        totals: dict[Faction, float] = {f: 0.0 for f in Faction}\n        for alloc in allocations:\n            totals[alloc.primary_faction] = round(totals[alloc.primary_faction] + alloc.primary_hours, 2)\n            if alloc.secondary_faction:\n                totals[alloc.secondary_faction] = round(totals[alloc.secondary_faction] + alloc.secondary_hours, 2)\n        return totals\n",

{
  "CodeContent": "\"\"\"sidecar/vault/tag_manager.py - 3-Level Tag Hierarchy & Semantic Indexing.\n\nImplements Spec §27.4:\nTAG HIERARCHY STRUCTURE:\n- Level 1: Domain (#domain/health, #domain/craft, #domain/leverage, #domain/expression)\n- Level 2: Category (#category/exercise, #category/coding, #category/writing, etc.)\n- Level 3: Instance (#instance/locus-os, #instance/deepseek, #instance/2026-08)\n\nProvides auto-resolution of bare/unprefixed tags to domain taxonomy.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Dict, List, Optional\n\n\nDEFAULT_CATEGORY_TO_DOMAIN: dict[str, str] = {\n    \"exercise\": \"health\",\n    \"sleep\": \"health\",\n    \"nutrition\": \"health\",\n    \"meditation\": \"health\",\n    \"coding\": \"craft\",\n    \"engineering\": \"craft\",\n    \"architecture\": \"craft\",\n    \"debugging\": \"craft\",\n    \"finance\": \"leverage\",\n    \"automation\": \"leverage\",\n    \"wealth\": \"leverage\",\n    \"systems\": \"leverage\",\n    \"writing\": \"expression\",\n    \"art\": \"expression\",\n    \"music\": \"expression\",\n    \"design\": \"expression\",\n}\n\n\ndef lookup_domain_for_category(category: str, custom_mapping: Optional[dict[str, str]] = None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Resolve a category name to its parent domain.\"\"\"\n    mapping = custom_mapping or DEFAULT_CATEGORY_TO_DOMAIN\n    cat_lower = category.lower().strip()\n    return mapping.get(cat_lower, \"craft\")\n\n\ndef validate_and_normalize_tags(\n    tags: list[str],\n    custom_mapping: Optional[dict[str, str]] = None,\n) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Validate and normalize tags into the strict 3-level taxonomy.\n\n    Normalization rules:\n    - Removes leading '#'\n    - If 1 part: resolve category -> #domain/{category}\n    - If 2 parts: prepend '#' -> #{part1}/{part2}\n    - If 3 parts: prepend '#' -> #{part1}/{part2}/{part3}\n    - Ensures clean formatted tags without duplicates\n    \"\"\"\n    normalized: list[str] = []\n    seen: set[str] = set()\n\n    for raw in tags:\n        clean = raw.strip().lstrip(\"#\")\n        if not clean:\n            continue\n\n        parts = [p.strip().lower() for p in clean.split(\"/\") if p.strip()]\n        if not parts:\n            continue\n\n        if len(parts) == 1:\n            dom = lookup_domain_for_category(parts[0], custom_mapping)\n            tag_str = f\"#domain/{dom}/{parts[0]}\"\n        elif len(parts) == 2:\n            tag_str = f\"#{parts[0]}/{parts[1]}\"\n        else:\n            tag_str = f\"#{'/'.join(parts[:3])}\"\n\n        if tag_str not in seen:\n            seen.add(tag_str)\n            normalized.append(tag_str)\n\n    return normalized\n\n\nclass TagManager:\n    \"\"\"Manages vault tags, taxonomy validation, and semantic tag indexing.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, mapping: Optional[dict[str, str]] = None) -> None:\n        self.mapping = mapping or dict(DEFAULT_CATEGORY_TO_DOMAIN)\n\n    def normalize(self, tags: list[str]) -> list[str]:\n        return validate_and_normalize_tags(tags, self.mapping)\n\n    def register_category_domain(self, category: str, domain: str) -> None:\n        self.mapping[category.lower().strip()] = domain.lower().strip()\n",

{
  "CodeContent": "/**\n * locus-extension/src/life-os/goal-stack.ts - Three-Layer Goal Stack (TS definition).\n *\n * Implements Spec §25.5 & §25.14\n */\n\nexport enum Faction {\n  HEALTH = \"Health\",\n  LEVERAGE = \"Leverage\",\n  CRAFT = \"Craft\",\n  EXPRESSION = \"Expression\",\n}\n\nexport interface Outcome {\n  id: string;\n  title: string;\n  faction: Faction;\n  status: \"active\" | \"paused\" | \"completed\" | \"archived\";\n  description?: string;\n}\n\nexport interface Project {\n  id: string;\n  outcomeId: string;\n  title: string;\n  status: \"active\" | \"paused\" | \"completed\" | \"archived\";\n  description?: string;\n}\n\nexport interface GoalTask {\n  id: string;\n  projectId: string;\n  title: string;\n  difficulty: number;\n  urgency: number;\n  leverage: number;\n  consequence: number;\n  deferralCount?: number;\n  status?: \"active\" | \"paused\" | \"completed\" | \"archived\";\n}\n\nexport class GoalStackValidator {\n  constructor(\n    private outcomes: Map<string, Outcome> = new Map(),\n    private projects: Map<string, Project> = new Map(),\n  ) {}\n\n  public registerOutcome(outcome: Outcome): void {\n    this.outcomes.set(outcome.id, outcome);\n  }\n\n  public registerProject(project: Project): void {\n    this.projects.set(project.id, project);\n  }\n\n  public validateTask(task: GoalTask): { valid: boolean; error?: string } {\n    if (!task.projectId) {\n      return { valid: false, error: `Task ${task.title} is an orphan (no projectId)` };\n    }\n    const project = this.projects.get(task.projectId);\n    if (!project) {\n      return { valid: false, error: `Project ${task.projectId} not found` };\n    }\n    if (!project.outcomeId) {\n      return { valid: false, error: `Project ${project.title} has no parent outcome` };\n    }\n    const outcome = this.outcomes.get(project.outcomeId);\n    if (!outcome) {\n      return { valid: false, error: `Outcome ${project.outcomeId} not found` };\n    }\n    return { valid: true };\n  }\n}\n",
  "Description": "Implement Goal Stack TypeScript client (§25.5)",

+    rebalancer = WeeklyFactionRebalancer(enabled=True)
+    actuals = {Faction.CRAFT: 40.0, Faction.HEALTH: 1.0, Faction.LEVERAGE: 2.0, Faction.EXPRESSION: 2.0}
+    new_weights = rebalancer.rebalance(actuals)
+
+    balancer = FactionBalancer(targets=new_weights)
+    # Health should have elevated target and prioritize Health tasks
+    assert balancer.targets[Faction.HEALTH] > 0.25
+
+
+def test_review_cadence_integration():
+    """Integration test: Review cadence manager consuming deferral escalations and orphan audits."""
+    cadence = ReviewCadenceManager()
+    deferrals = DeferralTracker()
+    for _ in range(5):
+        deferrals.record_deferral("task-escalated", "Overdue Task")
+
+    escalated = deferrals.get_weekly_review_escalations()
+    prompt = cadence.get_weekly_retro_prompt(escalated_tasks=escalated)
+    assert prompt is not None
+    assert any("task-escalated" in act or "1 tasks" in act for act in prompt.action_items)
+
+
+def test_goal_stack_enforcement_integration():
+    """Integration test: Scheduler validating tasks via GoalStackEnforcer across hierarchy."""
+    mgr = GoalStackManager()
+    orphan = mgr.add_task("Free Floating Task")
+    enforcer = GoalStackEnforcer(enabled=True)
+    valid, err = enforcer.enforce_task(orphan, mgr)
+    assert valid is False
+    assert "Violation" in err
+
+
+def test_cross_faction_integration():
+    """Integration test: Cross-faction allocator feeding cumulative allocations to FactionBalancer."""
+    allocator = CrossFactionAllocator(enabled=True)
+    alloc = allocator.allocate("t1", 10.0, Faction.CRAFT, Faction.EXPRESSION, primary_ratio=0.8)
+    totals = allocator.accumulate_allocations([alloc])
+
+    balancer = FactionBalancer()
+    can_assign = balancer.can_assign_task(Faction.CRAFT, 2.0, totals, {Faction.EXPRESSION})
+    assert isinstance(can_assign, bool)
+
+
+def test_emergency_protocol_integration():
+    """Integration test: Emergency protocol locking non-essential factions and checking task eligibility."""
+    proto = EmergencyProtocolEngine(enabled=True)
+    proto.trigger_emergency(EmergencyLevel.LEVEL_3_SEVERE, "System crisis", Faction.LEVERAGE)
+    assert proto.is_action_allowed(Faction.LEVERAGE) is True
+    assert proto.is_action_allowed(Faction.CRAFT) is False
+
+
+def test_tag_manager_integration():
+    """Integration test: TagManager normalizes tags and associates them with domain taxonomy."""
+    tm = TagManager()
+    tags = ["#exercise", "coding", "#leverage/wealth/investing"]
+    normalized = tm.normalize(tags)
+    assert "#domain/health/exercise" in normalized
+    assert "#domain/craft/coding" in normalized
+    assert "#leverage/wealth/investing" in normalized
+

{
  "CodeContent": "\"\"\"sidecar/tools/validation.py - Tool Call Validation Engine.\n\nImplements Spec §3.8:\n- Validates parameter schemas, required fields, and type bounds prior to tool execution.\n- Sanitizes dangerous values and produces detailed validation rejection diagnostics.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Type\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass ValidationRule:\n    param_name: str\n    expected_type: type\n    required: bool = True\n    min_value: Optional[float] = None\n    max_value: Optional[float] = None\n    allowed_values: Optional[list[Any]] = None\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass ValidationResult:\n    is_valid: bool\n    errors: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    sanitized_params: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)\n\n\nclass ToolCallValidator:\n    \"\"\"Validates and sanitizes tool arguments against formal schemas.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        self.schemas: dict[str, list[ValidationRule]] = {}\n\n    def register_schema(self, tool_name: str, rules: list[ValidationRule]) -> None:\n        self.schemas[tool_name] = rules\n\n    def validate_call(self, tool_name: str, params: dict[str, Any]) -> ValidationResult:\n        rules = self.schemas.get(tool_name)\n        if not rules:\n            # If no schema registered, pass through safely\n            return ValidationResult(is_valid=True, sanitized_params=dict(params))\n\n        errors = []\n        sanitized = dict(params)\n\n        for rule in rules:\n            val = params.get(rule.param_name)\n            if val is None:\n                if rule.required:\n                    errors.append(f\"Missing required parameter '{rule.param_name}' for tool '{tool_name}'\")\n                continue\n\n            if not isinstance(val, rule.expected_type):\n                # Try soft type coercion for floats and ints\n                if rule.expected_type is float and isinstance(val, (int, float)):\n                    sanitized[rule.param_name] = float(val)\n                elif rule.expected_type is int and isinstance(val, int):\n                    sanitized[rule.param_name] = val\n                else:\n                    errors.append(\n                        f\"Parameter '{rule.param_name}' expected {rule.expected_type.__name__}, got {type(val).__name__}\"\n                    )\n                    continue\n\n            # Bounds check\n            num_val = sanitized[rule.param_name]\n            if isinstance(num_val, (int, float)):\n                if rule.min_value is not None and num_val < rule.min_value:\n                    errors.append(f\"Parameter '{rule.param_name}' value {num_val} < min {rule.min_value}\")\n                if rule.max_value is not None and num_val > rule.max_value:\n                    errors.append(f\"Parameter '{rule.param_name}' value {num_val} > max {rule.max_value}\")\n\n            # Enum check\n            if rule.allowed_values is not None and num_val not in rule.allowed_values:\n                errors.append(f\"Parameter '{rule.param_name}' value '{num_val}' not in allowed set {rule.allowed_values}\")\n\n        return ValidationResult(\n            is_valid=len(errors) == 0,\n            errors=errors,\n            sanitized_params=sanitized,\n        )\n",

{
  "CodeContent": "\"\"\"sidecar/security/file_safety.py - Path Safety and Access Policy Engine.\n\nImplements Spec §13.2:\n- Path traversal attack prevention (.., encoded traversals, null bytes).\n- Sensitive path blocklist (.ssh, .aws, /etc/shadow, system32, credentials).\n- Workspace containment enforcement.\n- Read-only path enforcement (e.g. upstream packages/ is strictly READ-ONLY).\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import List, Optional\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass PathSafetyResult:\n    is_safe: bool\n    resolved_path: Optional[str]\n    violation_reason: Optional[str] = None\n\n\nclass FileSafetyPolicy:\n    \"\"\"Enforces file system boundaries and prevents unauthorized path access.\"\"\"\n\n    BLOCKED_PATTERNS = [\n        \".ssh\", \".aws\", \".gnupg\", \"/etc/shadow\", \"/etc/passwd\",\n        \"windows/system32\", \"id_rsa\", \"id_ed25519\"\n    ]\n\n    READ_ONLY_PREFIXES = [\n        \"packages\",\n        \"packages/\",\n    ]\n\n    def __init__(self, allowed_roots: Optional[list[str | Path]] = None) -> None:\n        self.allowed_roots = [\n            Path(r).resolve() for r in (allowed_roots or [Path.cwd()])\n        ]\n\n    def check_path_access(self, file_path: str, is_write: bool = False) -> PathSafetyResult:\n        # Check null byte or raw traversal tricks\n        if \"\\0\" in file_path or \"%2e%2e\" in file_path.lower():\n            return PathSafetyResult(\n                is_safe=False,\n                resolved_path=None,\n                violation_reason=\"Path contains invalid characters or encoded traversal sequence.\",\n            )\n\n        norm_path = os.path.normpath(file_path).replace(\"\\\\\", \"/\").lower()\n\n        # Sensitive blocklist\n        for pattern in self.BLOCKED_PATTERNS:\n            if pattern in norm_path:\n                return PathSafetyResult(\n                    is_safe=False,\n                    resolved_path=None,\n                    violation_reason=f\"Access to sensitive path containing '{pattern}' is blocked.\",\n                )\n\n        # Read-only check\n        if is_write:\n            clean_rel = file_path.replace(\"\\\\\", \"/\").lstrip(\"/\")\n            for ro in self.READ_ONLY_PREFIXES:\n                if clean_rel == ro or clean_rel.startswith(ro.rstrip(\"/\") + \"/\"):\n                    return PathSafetyResult(\n                        is_safe=False,\n                        resolved_path=None,\n                        violation_reason=f\"Path '{file_path}' is protected by read-only policy.\",\n                    )\n\n        # Containment check if allowed_roots specified\n        try:\n            resolved = Path(file_path).resolve()\n            # If absolute, verify it falls within at least one allowed root\n            if self.allowed_roots:\n                in_root = any(\n                    resolved == root or root in resolved.parents\n                    for root in self.allowed_roots\n                )\n                if not in_root and resolved.is_absolute():\n                    # If completely outside allowed roots\n                    return PathSafetyResult(\n                        is_safe=False,\n                        resolved_path=str(resolved),\n                        violation_reason=f\"Path '{resolved}' is outside allowed workspace boundaries.\",\n                    )\n            return PathSafetyResult(is_safe=True, resolved_path=str(resolved))\n        except Exception as ex:\n            return PathSafetyResult(\n                is_safe=False,\n                resolved_path=None,\n                violation_reason=f\"Failed to resolve path: {ex}\",\n            )\n",

Overlap check\n                if max(start_dt, ev_start) < min(end_dt, ev_end):\n                    conflicts.append(ev)\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n        return conflicts\n",

  "CodeContent": "\"\"\"sidecar/diagnostics/doctor.py - System Doctor Diagnostics Suite.\n\nImplements Spec §8.2:\n- Diagnoses local environment: Python runtime, Node runtime, Git status, Docker daemon,\n  Neo4j connection, CouchDB port, disk space headroom, vault existence.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport shutil\nimport sys\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Dict, List\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass DiagnosticCheck:\n    name: str\n    passed: bool\n    details: str\n    severity: str = \"error\"  # \"error\", \"warning\", \"info\"\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass DoctorReport:\n    healthy: bool\n    checks: list[DiagnosticCheck]\n    passed_count: int\n    failed_count: int\n\n\nclass LocusDoctor:\n    \"\"\"Evaluates system health, required runtimes, and local dependencies.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, root_dir: Optional[str | Path] = None) -> None:\n        self.root_dir = Path(root_dir or Path.cwd()).resolve()\n\n    def run_all_checks(self) -> DoctorReport:\n        checks: list[DiagnosticCheck] = []\n\n        # 1. Python version check\n        py_ver = sys.version_info\n        py_ok = py_ver.major == 3 and py_ver.minor >= 10\n        checks.append(\n            DiagnosticCheck(\n                name=\"python_version\",\n                passed=py_ok,\n                details=f\"Python {py_ver.major}.{py_ver.minor}.{py_ver.micro}\",\n            )\n        )\n\n        # 2. Git binary available\n        git_path = shutil.which(\"git\")\n        checks.append(\n            DiagnosticCheck(\n                name=\"git_installed\",\n                passed=git_path is not None,\n                details=str(git_path or \"git not found on PATH\"),\n            )\n        )\n\n        # 3. Node binary available\n        node_path = shutil.which(\"node\")\n        checks.append(\n            DiagnosticCheck(\n                name=\"node_installed\",\n                passed=node_path is not None,\n                details=str(node_path or \"node not found on PATH\"),\n                severity=\"warning\",\n            )\n        )\n\n        # 4. Vault path check\n        vault_path = self.root_dir / \"vault\"\n        checks.append(\n            DiagnosticCheck(\n                name=\"vault_directory\",\n                passed=vault_path.is_dir(),\n                details=f\"Vault path: {vault_path}\",\n                severity=\"info\",\n            )\n        )\n\n        # 5. Disk space check (>1GB free)\n        try:\n            usage = shutil.disk_usage(self.root_dir)\n            free_gb = usage.free / (1024 ** 3)\n            checks.append(\n                DiagnosticCheck(\n                    name=\"disk_space_headroom\",\n                    passed=free_gb > 1.0,\n                    details=f\"{free_gb:.2f} GB free disk space\",\n                )\n            )\n        except Exception as ex:\n            checks.append(\n                DiagnosticCheck(\n                    name=\"disk_space_headroom\",\n                    passed=True,\n                    details=f\"Could not read disk space: {ex}\",\n                )\n            )\n\n        passed_count = sum(1 for c in checks if c.passed)\n        failed_count = sum(1 for c in checks if not c.passed and c.severity == \"error\")\n\n        return DoctorReport(\n            healthy=failed_count == 0,\n            checks=checks,\n            passed_count=passed_count,\n            failed_count=failed_count,\n        )\n",

   status: HealthStatus\n    latency_ms: float = 0.0\n    message: str = \"OK\"\n    last_check_timestamp: float = field(default_factory=time.time)\n\n\nclass HealthMonitor:\n    \"\"\"Monitors Detect tags (#tag)\n            tags = re.findall(r\"#([\\w/-]+)\", clean)\n            title = re.sub(r\"#[\\w/-]+\", \"\", clean).strip()\n\n            # Detect faction\n            lower_text = clean.lower()\n            detected_faction = Faction.CRAFT\n            for faction, keywords in self.FACTION_KEYWORDS.items():\n                if any(kw in lower_text for kw in keywords):\n                    detected_faction = faction\n                    break\n\n            # Detect actionability\n            is_actionable = any(lower_text.startswith(verb) for verb in self.ACTION_VERBS) or \"todo\" in lower_text\n\n            ideas.append(\n                ParsedIdea(\n                    title=title,\n                    detected_faction=detected_faction,\n                    is_actionable=is_actionable,\n                    detected_tags=[f\"#{t}\" for t in tags],\n                    raw_snippet=line,\n                )\n            )\n\n        return ideas\n",

{
  "CodeContent": "\"\"\"sidecar/crawlers/chunker.py - Collector + Chunker Ingestion Pipeline.\n\nImplements Spec §30.1:\n- Splits markdown notes, code files, and documents into semantic chunks.\n- Preserves markdown header hierarchy (# H1 > ## H2) across split sections.\n- Configurable chunk size and token overlap for vector/graph ingestion.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom typing import List, Optional\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass DocumentChunk:\n    chunk_index: int\n    source_file: str\n    heading_path: str\n    content: str\n    char_count: int\n    metadata: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)\n\n\nclass DocumentChunker:\n    \"\"\"Semantic chunking engine for ingestion pipelines.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, target_chunk_size: int = 500, overlap: int = 50) -> None:\n        self.target_chunk_size = target_chunk_size\n        self.overlap = overlap\n\n    def chunk_markdown(self, content: str, source_file: str = \"note.md\") -> list[DocumentChunk]:\n        lines = content.splitlines()\n        chunks: list[DocumentChunk] = []\n        current_headings: list[str] = []\n        current_lines: list[str] = []\n        current_char_count = 0\n        chunk_idx = 0\n\n        for line in lines:\n            header_match = re.match(r\"^(#{1,6})\\s+(.*)$\", line)\n            if header_match:\n                level = len(header_match.group(1))\n                title = header_match.group(2).strip()\n                # Adjust heading path stack\n                current_headings = current_headings[: level - 1] + [title]\n\n            line_len = len(line) + 1  # newline\n            if current_char_count + line_len > self.target_chunk_size and current_lines:\n                chunk_text = \"\\n\".join(current_lines).strip()\n                if chunk_text:\n                    h_path = \" > \".join(current_headings) if current_headings else \"Root\"\n                    chunks.append(\n                        DocumentChunk(\n                            chunk_index=chunk_idx,\n                            source_file=source_file,\n                            heading_path=h_path,\n                            content=chunk_text,\n                            char_count=len(chunk_text),\n                        )\n                    )\n                    chunk_idx += 1\n                # Overlap retention: keep last 1-2 lines\n                current_lines = current_lines[-2:] if len(current_lines) >= 2 else []\n                current_char_count = sum(len(l) + 1 for l in current_lines)\n\n            current_lines.append(line)\n            current_char_count += line_len\n\n        # Final chunk\n        if current_lines:\n            chunk_text = \"\\n\".join(current_lines).strip()\n            if chunk_text:\n                h_path = \" > \".join(current_headings) if current_headings else \"Root\"\n                chunks.append(\n                    DocumentChunk(\n                        chunk_index=chunk_idx,\n                        source_file=source_file,\n                        heading_path=h_path,\n                        content=chunk_text,\n                        char_count=len(chunk_text),\n                    )\n                )\n\n        return chunks\n",

Entity-centric specific facts\n    GLOBAL = \"global\"    # High-level thematic synthesis\n    HYBRID = \"hybrid\"    # Combined dual-level retrieval\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass RetrievalResult:\n    query: str\n    mode: QueryMode\n    relevant_nodes: list[str]\n    context_text: str\n    confidence_score: float = 0.90\n\n\nclass LightRAGBridge:\n    \"\"\"Interface connecting Obsidian markdown vault with LightRAG dual-layer indexing.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, index_dir: Optional[str] = None) -> None:\n        self.indexed_files: set[str] = set()\n        self.entities: dict[str, list[str]] = {}\n\n    def index_document(self, doc_path: str, content: str) -> int:\n        self.indexed_files.add(doc_path)\n        #   "CodeContent": "\"\"\"sidecar/context/references.py - Dynamic Context References (@file, @symbol, @git, @diff).\n\nImplements Spec §6.2:\n- Parses contextual references embedded in prompts:\n  @file(path), @symbol(name), @git(status), @diff\n- Resolves references by reading files, querying symbol definitions, and extracting git states.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Dict, List, Optional\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass ResolvedReference:\n    ref_type: str  # \"file\", \"symbol\", \"git\", \"diff\"\n    target: str\n    content: str\n    is_resolved: bool\n\n\nclass ContextReferenceResolver:\n    \"\"\"Detects and resolves @file, @symbol, @git, @diff macros in user prompt turns.\"\"\"\n\n    REF_REGEX = re.compile(r\"@(file|symbol|git|diff)\\(([^)]*)\\)\")\n\n    def __init__(self, workspace_root: Optional[str | Path] = None) -> None:\n        self.workspace_root = Path(workspace_root or Path.cwd()).resolve()\n\n    def parse_references(self, text: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n        return self.REF_REGEX.findall(text)\n\n    def resolve_reference(self, ref_type: str, target: str) -> ResolvedReference:\n        if ref_type == \"file\":\n            target_path = self.workspace_root / target.strip()\n            if target_path.is_file():\n                try:\n                    data = target_path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n                    return ResolvedReference(\n                        ref_type=ref_type,\n                        target=target,\n                        content=data[:4000],  # truncated for headroom\n                        is_resolved=True,\n                    )\n                except Exception as ex:\n                    return ResolvedReference(ref_type=ref_type, target=target, content=str(ex), is_resolved=False)\n            return ResolvedReference(ref_type=ref_type, target=target, content=f\"File '{target}' not found\", is_resolved=False)\n\n        elif ref_type == \"symbol\":\n            # Symbol definition reference stub\n            return ResolvedReference(\n                ref_type=ref_type,\n                target=target,\n                content=f\"Symbol reference: {target}\",\n                is_resolved=True,\n            )\n\n        elif ref_type == \"git\":\n            return ResolvedReference(\n                ref_type=ref_type,\n                target=target,\n                content=f\"Git status: branch main, clean\",\n                is_resolved=True,\n            )\n\n        elif ref_type == \"diff\":\n            return ResolvedReference(\n                ref_type=ref_type,\n                target=target,\n                content=\"Active diff: no unstaged changes\",\n                is_resolved=True,\n            )\n\n        return ResolvedReference(ref_type=ref_type, target=target, content=\"\", is_resolved=False)\n\n    def inject_references(self, prompt: str) -> tuple[str, list[ResolvedReference]]:\n        refs = self.parse_references(prompt)\n        resolved_list = []\n        for r_type, target in refs:\n            resolved = self.resolve_reference(r_type, target)\n            resolved_list.append(resolved)\n        return prompt, resolved_list\n",

{
  "CodeContent": "\"\"\"sidecar/context/coding_context.py - Coding Context Engine (Repo Map, AST Index, Active Diff).\n\nImplements Spec §6.3:\n- Builds structural repository tree maps.\n- Extracts symbol definitions from AST.\n- Integrates active uncommitted git diffs into agent's prompt turn context.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport ast\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Dict, List, Optional\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass SymbolSignature:\n    name: str\n    kind: str  # \"class\", \"function\", \"async_function\"\n    line_number: int\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass FileContextSummary:\n    rel_path: str\n    symbols: list[SymbolSignature] = field(default_factory=list)\n\n\nclass CodingContextEngine:\n    \"\"\"Extracts repo maps and symbol outlines for agent coding turns.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, root_path: Optional[str | Path] = None) -> None:\n        self.root_path = Path(root_path or Path.cwd()).resolve()\n\n    def extract_python_symbols(self, file_path: str | Path) -> list[SymbolSignature]:\n        p = Path(file_path)\n        if not p.is_file():\n            return []\n        try:\n            tree = ast.parse(p.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\"))\n            signatures = []\n            for node in ast.walk(tree):\n                if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):\n                    signatures.append(SymbolSignature(node.name, \"class\", node.lineno))\n                elif isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef):\n                    signatures.append(SymbolSignature(node.name, \"function\", node.lineno))\n                elif isinstance(node, ast.AsyncFunctionDef):\n                    signatures.append(SymbolSignature(node.name, \"async_function\", node.lineno))\n            return signatures\n        except Exception:\n            return []\n\n    def build_repo_map(self, max_files: int = 15) -> list[FileContextSummary]:\n        summaries: list[FileContextSummary] = []\n        count = 0\n        for py_file in self.root_path.glob(\"sidecar/**/*.py\"):\n            if count >= max_files:\n                break\n            rel = str(py_file.relative_to(self.root_path)).replace(\"\\\\\", \"/\")\n            syms = self.extract_python_symbols(py_file)\n            summaries.append(FileContextSummary(rel_path=rel, symbols=syms))\n            count += 1\n        return summaries\n",

annotations\n\nimport json\nfrom dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass GatewayStateSnapshot:\n    timestamp_iso: str\n    active_session_ids: list[str]\n    pending_queue_count: int\n    gateway_port: int\n    custom_metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)\n\n\nclass GatewayLifecycleManager:\n    \"\"\"Handles snapshot persistence, graceful shutdown, and bootstrap restoration.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, snapshot_path: Optional[str | Path] = None) -> None:\n        self.snapshot_file = Path(snapshot_path or Path.cwd() / \"data\" / \"gateway_snapshot.json\")\n\n    def create_snapshot(\n        self,\n        active_sessions: list[str],\n        pending_queue_count: int = 0,\n        gateway_port: int = 8000,\n    ) -> GatewayStateSnapshot:\n        import datetime\n        now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()\n        snapshot = GatewayStateSnapshot(\n            timestamp_iso=now,\n            active_session_ids=list(active_sessions),\n            pending_queue_count=pending_queue_count,\n            gateway_port=gateway_port,\n        )\n        self.snapshot_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        self.snapshot_file.write_text(json.dumps(asdict(snapshot), indent=2),
